Caretta gets smarter automatically: every call expands its knowledge base and objection library, turning conversations into compounding organizational advantage.
one_liner: Realtime AI for Sales Calls

name: Oximy
long_description: Oximy is one platform to see every AI tool and dollar across your company, run your team’s work in an app you own, and route every request to the right model.
one_liner: Take command of the AI your company already runs on.

name: AxionOrbital Space
long_description:
AxionOrbital Space builds foundation models that enable continuous visibility through clouds and darkness. Legacy optical satellites are rendered useless 70% of the time by weather and night cycles, while Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) produces data that is unintelligible to humans and breaks standard vision pipelines.

We solve this by translating raw radar backscatter into analysis-ready optical imagery in real-time. Our proprietary architecture uses deterministic one-step diffusion to transform complex radar signals into clear, photorealistic images. This enables persistent, 24/7 situational awareness for defense, commodities trading, and disaster response, guaranteeing visibility even when the sky is blocked.
one_liner: Foundation models for 24/7 Earth Observation

name: Mendral
long_description: Mendral is an AI DevOps Engineer that observes, diagnoses, acts, and learns continuously. It autonomously handles CI failures, flaky tests, slow builds, broken releases, and code reviews, improving with every build and run. Over time, Mendral evolves into a self-improving delivery system that manages performance, quality, security, and compliance, all without manual intervention.
one_liner: AI DevOps Engineer

name: Sazabi
long_description: The AI-native observability platform for fast-moving engineering teams. Backed by tastemakers from the world's top AI companies: Vercel, Graphite, Daytona, Browserbase, LangChain, Mastra, Replit, and more.
one_liner: The AI-native observability platform for fast-moving engineering teams

name: Constellation Space
long_description:
Constellation Space is building the autonomous infrastructure layer for the next generation of space networking. As satellite constellations rapidly scale from hundreds of nodes to tens of thousands, traditional ground-based orchestration fundamentally breaks down. ConstellationOS bridges this gap by providing zero-intervention network handoffs, predictive thermal load-balancing, and sub-second optical routing.

Our founding team spent years building and operating satellite systems at SpaceX, Blue Origin, and NASA. We started Constellation to solve the problem we kept running into: reactive monitoring doesn't scale.

We are building the sub-second routing protocols and hyperscale load-balancing infrastructure that will manage the future of off-world telecommunications and compute. 

hello@constellation-io.com
one_liner: AI operating system for mega-scale satellite networks.

name: Byteport
long_description: Founded in 2025, Byteport is a technology company that builds mission-critical network infrastructure for robotics, satellite, AI, and enterprise applications all over the world. Businesses of every size—from new startups to public companies—use our software to accelerate file transfer online.
one_liner: Global upload acceleration for 1GB-100TB files.

name: Pocket
long_description: Pocket is a Y Combinator W26 company building a premium hardware plus software product in the AI voice recorder space. We are obsessed with quality and speed. We are scaling very fast in the US and now European markets and building a device experience that can become the category leader.
one_liner: Take Notes in the Real World

name: Bubble Lab
long_description:
Bubble Lab is the home base for premium professional communities.

We help career networks, investor communities, and operator collectives launch branded member hubs with directories, applications, payments, Slack sync, onboarding automation, analytics, and warm 1:1 matchmaking — so a single operator can run a community that feels personal and high-touch, without the ops headache.
one_liner: Operating system for premium professional communities

name: Archal
long_description: Modern AI agents can send emails, change code repos, and talk with external APIs. Archal verifies your agent takes the right actions, and opens a fix PR when it doesn't.
one_liner: The improvement loop for AI agents

name: Polymath
long_description: Polymath is a data lab focused on improving long-horizon agent capabilities and alignment
one_liner: Simulation environments to train & evaluate long-horizon AI agents

name: Voxel Energy
long_description:
The best grid connection is no grid connection. Voxel builds vertically integrated energy generation and storage systems for data centers that bypass utility connection delays. 

By leveraging the vast supply of second-life EV batteries and our novel DC microgrid architecture, Voxel generates datacenter power on site and drastically reduces system cost and time-to-power.
one_liner: Energy independent data centers with solar and repurposed batteries.

name: Netter
long_description:
Netter (YC P26) helps companies regain control over their data, so teams can pilot their activities with high precision.

Most companies are sitting on years of valuable data, spread across different formats and disconnected tools that don't talk to each other.

Netter brings technical capacity to companies that don't have an army of data engineers, and tackles their most complex data challenges.

- A nursing home group was chasing unpaid invoices manually across disconnected tools. Netter centralized the collection workflows, automated reminders, real-time visibility, task routing.
- A retail chain had years of loyalty card data sitting unused. Netter cross-referenced it with public demographic data to build precise customer segments and trigger the right promotions to the right people.
one_liner: AI native Palantir for mid market.

name: Superset
long_description:
Superset is an open-source IDE that helps engineers run 100s of coding agents in parallel.

Our desktop app is loved by tens of thousands of engineers, and we're scaling out our effort to build a collaborative, cross-platform tool to allow users to code anywhere.
one_liner: Building self-improving software

name: Datoric
long_description:
Datoric provides custom training data for voice models, robotics, and world models. We manage the full process from contributor recruitment and task design to secure collection, quality control, rights management, and delivery.

Our collection infrastructure is private by design. Voice, robotics, and world-model projects run through separate applications and sites, so contributor pools, task requirements, incentives, and data flows do not mix across modalities. Within each system, customer projects are isolated in private workspaces. Only approved contributors can access assigned tasks, with no public task listings, upload links, or contributor APIs.

We also build quality into the collection process instead of relying only on review after the data arrives. Contributors are qualified and matched before they participate, collection requirements are enforced inside each workflow, and early submissions are tested before a project scales. Every sample is then linked to its contributor, consent, usage rights, collection history, and review record.

Datoric’s mission is to make human-generated training data more secure, reliable, and responsibly sourced from the moment it is created.
one_liner: Security-first training data

name: Servo7
long_description:
We deploy robots in warehouses to automate the most demanding job in logistics: unloading loose-loaded containers.

Our customers include 3PLs (CEVA, Stord), distributors (DHL, PostNL) and many more logistics companies.
one_liner: Container unloading robots for warehouses

name: Ditto Biosciences
long_description:
Ditto Bio discovers drugs for autoimmune diseases by harnessing parasite biology. Viruses, ticks, and worms have experimented over millions of years to create proteins that control the human immune system. We use AI to identify these proteins and engineer them into next-generation autoimmune therapies.

Our team is three PhD scientists from UCSF, UCSD, and UC Berkeley who have worked together for 3+ years in biotech. We have deep expertise in parasite biology, computational biology, and software for AI-based protein structure prediction
one_liner: Evolutionary intelligence for autoimmune disease

name: Libra Robotics
long_description:
We build collaborative robot squads for solar farm construction.

High labor costs, labor shortages, and unpredictable productivity make infrastructure difficult to build in places that are remote, harsh, or empty. We are building robots to unlock places once considered too difficult to develop. Solar farm is our first proving ground.

Unlike solutions that automate only one task, or even part of one, we cover the workflow after PV module pallets arrive on-site: transportation, installation, alignment, and fastening. Each robot has a specific role, and fleets can be configured based on each project’s cost and schedule requirements.

Our robots operate autonomously with remote supervision. One person can supervise 4+ robots through a screen and an e-stop button, without being physically present or teleoperating them. Our robotic fleet has also been tested at night, paving the way for 24/7 operation.

We work directly with EPCs through a Robotics-as-a-Service model, requiring no robot purchase or large upfront capital investment. We also work with racking and PV module manufacturers to certify compatibility and give customers confidence in deployment.

Purpose-built hardware, multimodal sensing, and physical AI software help our robots handle real-world construction uncertainty.
one_liner: Robot squads for solar farm construction

name: Sequence Markets
long_description:
Sequence Markets lets traders execute across crypto exchanges, prediction markets, and tokenized-asset venues from one system.

We built proprietary low-latency infrastructure and routing software so users can package one market view into one trade with the speed, access, and transparency execution requires.
one_liner: Low-latency execution across crypto, prediction, and tokenized assets

name: Doomersion
long_description:
Doomersion (formerly Doomlingo) lets you learn languages by doomsrolling! Watch TikToks in your target language that are exactly matched to your level, and as you scroll, they get a little bit harder.

Gen-Z doomscrolls 2.5-3 hours a day, and if we bake immersion into that by only showing them viral videos in another language that are matched to their level, we can make the optimal language learning method addictive for people. Hence the name, doomersion.

The app gained ~15k downloads in the first two weeks, and power users spend ~3+ hours daily on the app. Feel free to download and try it yourself!
one_liner: Doomscroll to learn languages

name: o11
long_description:
o11 is the AI data warehouse for financial firms. The largest firms build a moat around their data. Today, they pay engineers $200k a year each to spend years organizing/maintaining disconnected sources in a legacy data warehouse. The business intelligence that results is the key unlock, but it's time effort and money that would be better spent elsewhere.

o11 brings a custom ontology and data model to firms of any size allowing them to unify CRM, email, files, data rooms, market data, M365, etc. all in one place. We help firms architect their own data warehouse, and then from their AI maintains it. No engineers, no legacy solutions, no complex migration. o11 is built for security and complex permissions from the ground up allowing it to safely connect directly into any agent including Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot.

Leverage your proprietary data -- it's the deal, relationship, and business intelligence that makes your firm special
one_liner: The AI Data Warehouse For Financial Firms

name: Anchorhead
long_description: Fractional buyer for hardware companies manufacturing experimental parts in critical industries
one_liner: Fractional buyer for hardware companies in critical industries

name: Remy AI
long_description: Building robots and training models for automating manipulation in warehouse, starting with e-commerce 3PLs
one_liner: Automating dexterous tasks in warehouses with AI-powered robots

name: Chasi
long_description:
Chasi deploys AI agents that help equipment dealers sell more, respond faster, and maximize fleet utilization - 24/7.

One-third of the cost to build and maintain the physical world goes to equipment, yet fleet utilization across the industry often sits below 60%. Billions in assets sit idle while dealers drown in phone calls, emails, and manual data entry. Missed quotes, slow follow-ups, and disconnected systems mean lost revenue every day.

Chasi plugs into a dealer's existing stack to deploy AI agents that handle sales, rentals, and service requests around the clock. The result: faster response times, higher utilization, and stronger margins, without adding headcount. We automate the busywork so teams can focus on what actually grows the business: customer relationships.

Akash Pavan and Sarman Aulakh have built tractors, race cars, and robots, and previously led AI deployments at Tesla, Boeing, and Cummins, where they saw firsthand how much operational value gets left on the table in equipment-heavy industries. Chasi is live across equipment businesses in the US and Europe.
one_liner: AI Revenue Engine for the Equipment Industry

name: Ekpa
one_liner: Building Autonomous Research Agents for Trading

name: Balance
long_description: Balance is an AI accounting firm that helps SMBs close their monthly books. Our agents do the work of an in-house finance hire, reconciling books in real time and flagging issues before they become problems.
one_liner: Full-Stack AI Accounting

name: Fort
long_description: Fort is a wearable that tracks strength training for people who care about longevity. Other wearables make you manually log every rep, set, and exercise, then provide unhelpful feedback or underestimate strength-related fatigue. We use heart rate and motion data to track your strength workouts for you, then provide thoughtful, actionable feedback that helps you achieve your goals.
one_liner: Strength Tracking Wearable

name: General Legal
long_description: We're the elite AI law firm for high growth companies. Our firm provides exceptional, top-of-market legal work across commercial, corporate and employment law, at speeds and prices that put traditional law firms to shame.
one_liner: Elite AI law firm for high growth companies

name: Corelayer
long_description:
Corelayer is the AI-native platform for production software support, built for regulated industries like finance and healthcare. It continuously monitors alerts, logs, infrastructure, and underlying data for issues and uses agents to debug and suggest fixes.

We're helping SRE, production services, and on-call engineers at companies ranging from growth-stage fintechs to Fortune 500 financial institutions spend less time on support and more on high-leverage work.
one_liner: AI production engineer for regulated industries

name: Booko
long_description: Booko helps businesses that sell bookable time slots make more money by dynamically pricing their time. Unlike physical inventory, unsold time slots disappear forever, yet most time-slot-based businesses still rely on static pricing. We integrate with existing booking systems to adjust prices and incentives based on historical utilization, availability, and demand. Early customers see ~20% revenue uplift by selling time that would have otherwise gone unsold.
one_liner: Dynamically pricing the whole economy.

name: Foreman
long_description:
Foreman is the all-in-one AI-powered project management platform built for construction contractors and the trade industry.
Today, contractors run complex businesses on a patchwork of tools that were never designed for construction — estimates in spreadsheets, plans in email, proposals copy-pasted from old Word docs, photos scattered across phones. Nothing talks to anything else, and the admin work never stops.
Foreman replaces that patchwork with a single platform that manages the full lifecycle of a construction job, from first estimate to final invoice. Contractors upload plans, photos, or a project description, and Foreman's AI instantly generates structured takeoffs, scoped estimates, and professional proposals — in minutes, not hours. From there, every customer record, document, permit, photo, change order, and conversation lives in one place, organized around the job.
The result: contractors spend less time buried in admin and more time building. They bid faster, manage jobs with less chaos, and close projects cleanly — without duct-taping five tools together to do it.
one_liner: Keeping contractors on the job site, not behind a desk.

name: Squid
long_description:
We believe the electricity grid is the most important machine on Earth. If we want electrification to move fast, the teams planning and operating networks need software that is as modern as the challenge.

Our thesis is simple. Better decisions come from one unified, trusted network model. When everyone works from the same model, planning becomes consistent, assumptions are visible, and progress stops getting lost in spreadsheets and static reports.

Squid is AI powered grid planning in your browser. We have spent years inside National Grid, Octopus Energy, and AWS, building and learning what breaks. Now we are building what we wished existed.
one_liner: AI agents for power grid planning  🦑

name: Inth
long_description:
Inth helps fast-moving software teams prevent privacy failures before they reach production.

Privacy risk no longer lives in policy docs, dashboards, and questionnaires. It lives in code: consent flows, data deletion, vendors, logs, AI systems, and agent-written changes that move user data every day.

Inth starts with c15t, an open-source consent and privacy SDK with 3M+ npm downloads, used by teams like Zed, Infisical, and Expo. From there, Inth expands into code-native workflows for consent management, data subject requests, policy enforcement, vendor oversight, and audit-ready evidence.

We make privacy governance programmable, observable, and compliant by default.
one_liner: Enterprise privacy governance for companies that ship fast

name: Fed10
long_description:
Fed10 is a legislative consulting firm staffed by AI agents. 

We monitor every bill across the U.S., flag threats to your business, and deliver actionable insights — the same work a $500/hr policy consultant does, but in seconds instead of days.

Built by three ex-lobbyists who passed legislation together.
one_liner: AI Agents for Government Affairs

name: BeeSafe AI
long_description:
BeeSafe AI is building the frontier model layer for social engineering defense. Cyberattacks have moved from code to conversation: attackers now use AI to carry out long-term, trust-based manipulation across SMS, voice, email, and social platforms, often inside encrypted channels where defenders cannot see, detect, or stop them.

BeeSafe changes that by deploying undercover AI agents that engage attackers directly, expose hidden infrastructure, and convert live adversarial conversations into actionable intelligence. Each engagement adds to BeeSafe's proprietary dataset of real attacker behavior and trains foundational models that continually learn about counter-persuasion, deception, and manipulation in the wild.

BeeSafe is starting in financial crime, where banks already value our data against Authorized Push Payment (APP) fraud and money laundering, but the opportunity is far broader. The same data and models that uncover mule networks today can protect consumers, secure enterprises, and strengthen governments against the next generation of AI-powered social engineering attacks tomorrow.
one_liner: Frontier AI Defenses for Social Engineering Attacks

name: Meteoric
long_description: Meteoric is building drones that clear clouds over solar farms to increase output.
one_liner: Drones that clear clouds over solar farms

name: The Token Company
long_description:
Compression middleware that removes context bloat in milliseconds, lowering costs and improving end-to-end latency.

Compression is especially effective across natural language workloads. In a blind LLM arena case study with one of our customers, compressed requests increased user preference, lowered costs, and lifted purchase volume by 5%.
one_liner: Compression middleware that improves LLM outputs

name: Moda
long_description:
Moda is the continual learning layer for AI agents. It turns production agent traces into validated improvements for your agent harness. It surfaces patterns across agent hallucinations, laziness, context loss, and tool call failures, then attributes each issue to a specific layer of the agent harness: prompts, tools, workflows, retrieval, memory, and evals. It also discovers what users are actually trying to do and turns those findings into concrete counterfactuals the team can ship.

In the next 10 years, with more AI agents spawning and trying to get PMF, developing an agent that actually works for users is critical. Everyone has access to the same models, thus the ones that win on a product level will be the ones who learn fastest from real usage. Moda is that learning layer.
one_liner: The continual learning layer for AI agents.

name: Maven
long_description: We enable AI voice agents to collect payments over the phone through a single API call, handling card processing and PCI compliance across all payment gateways
one_liner: Payments Infrastructure for Voice Agents

name: Sila
long_description: Sila is the agent-native messaging platform. We're defining the standard for how companies work in the AI era by creating new types of communication layers: team-agent, agent-agent, agent-customer interaction layers and more. The conversations that define the future will happen on Sila.
one_liner: Agent-Native Messaging Platform

name: Grade
long_description: Grade is the API for performance-based payroll. Think of us like Deel or Gusto, but our payouts are for work completed, not hours. Companies use Grade to pay AI agents and contractors based on results: tasks completed, targets hit, work delivered. We handle compliance, tax reporting, and global payouts.
one_liner: API for performance-based payroll

name: Canary
long_description: AI coding tools have made developers 100x faster but customer-facing incidents are up 43% YoY, QA hasn't kept up. Canary is the first AI QA engineer that understands your codebase. Instead of relying on flaky DOM scraping or screenshot analysis, Canary reads your source code directly to understand developer intent and catch broken user flows before they hit production. Engineering teams go from weeks of manual testing to 90%+ coverage in days. Built by a team that built coding agents at Windsurf, Cognition and Google.
one_liner: The first AI QA engineer that understands your code

name: Atlia
long_description:
We are making the AI-native property management company. 

We manage short-term rental properties by running operations completely autonomously, letting us operate with extremely low overheads. This lets us offer the best owner and guest experiences with the lowest management rates in the country.

Our services are initially starting in the greater San Diego and Fort Lauderdale regions.
one_liner: We are the AI-native property management company
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

name: Dream
long_description:
Dream makes pocket-sized, battery-powered AI cameras that catch damage teams miss. Car dealerships, equipment rental companies, fleets, and more move expensive assets in and out all day, and undocumented damage is a costly leak.

Dream cameras are simple to set up and work automatically. Each vehicle or machine that passes is photographed from every angle, identified, and reconstructed into a 3D condition record. On return or intake, Dream instantly flags new dents, scrapes, and changes your team might miss, giving one source of truth for every asset's condition over time.

Ryland worked at X/xAI and built aerial damage-detection vision at Vexcel Imaging. Alexander worked at AWS and trained edge-camera models deployed in the wild across Africa and India to detect poachers.
one_liner: Pocket-sized AI cameras that catch asset damage.

name: Tsenta
long_description:
Tsenta is an AI career agent that finds matching jobs, tailors your resume, and applies on your behalf.

We built it after manually applying to over 3,000 jobs ourselves, so nobody else would have to.

Today, more than 70,000 job seekers use Tsenta to automate their job search.
one_liner: AI career agent that finds matching jobs and applies for you

name: Copperlane
long_description: Copperlane helps mortgage lenders accelerate the loan process and reduce mistakes in an application. We use AI agents to understand an applicant's profile, verify their documents, and complete initial underwriting tasks.
one_liner: Agentic Mortgage Origination

name: Control Seat
long_description:
Control Seat builds the hardware and software that helps industrial teams see, understand, and run their operations.

Our platform creates one clear source of truth across the plant. It connects the systems teams already use, brings control, monitoring, history, and machine health together, and adds an intelligence layer that continuously watches for meaningful changes. Teams can understand what happened, catch problems earlier, and act before they become downtime.

The result is fewer surprises, faster decisions, and less time spent piecing together information across disconnected tools.

We work with manufacturers, utilities, energy companies, and other industrial operators modernizing existing facilities or building new ones.
one_liner: Control and Monitoring of Industrial Operations

name: Talking Computers
long_description:
We deploy fleets of AI Infrastructure Engineers to collaborate over week-long time horizons, run 100s of experiments in parallel, and learn from them to optimize your training/ inference infrastructure to your workloads.

We've partnered with companies to speed up their GPU kernels to 6x SOTA, and improved the latency of voice models to twice the competition.
one_liner: AI for AI Infrastructure

name: Supafax
long_description: Supafax is an AI agent that lives in your inbox and proactively manages your email and calendar.
one_liner: AI assistant for your email and calendar

name: Vela
long_description:
Scheduling one interview panel takes a dozen emails. Then someone moves a call and you start over. 

Vela is an AI Scheduling Coordinator that handles it end to end. Just CC Vela on the thread like you would a person. It reaches out, finds times that work for everyone, chases the people who don't reply, reschedules when things change, and confirms. Over email, SMS, and WhatsApp, at any hour your candidate happens to respond.

No dashboard. No new workflow. Your team works the way it already works, without the scheduling.
one_liner: AI Recruiting Coordinator for Executive Search

name: Cova
long_description: Cova is an AI-native home care agency, licensed in Michigan. We serve Medicaid, LTCI, and private-pay patients; we pay caregivers the highest base rate in the state; and we help unpaid family caregivers get paid through programs they didn't know they qualified for. Our entire operation runs on AI agents, which means less overhead and more value passed directly to the people doing the real work.
one_liner: AI-Native Home Care Agency

name: MochaCare
long_description: MochaCare is an agentic management service for care organizations. We handle hiring, scheduling, and client intake end-to-end so our partners can focus on growth.
one_liner: Agentic Management Service for Care Organizations

name: VOYGR
long_description:
VOYGR is a better maps API every agent and AI app will need. Google says '4.2 stars, open till 10 – VOYGR knows the chef left, wait times doubled, and locals moved on. Our intelligent local search combines accurate place data with fresh web context – news, articles, and events. We expand beyond 10-15 map attributes into infinite, queryable place profiles, enabling agents to reason and act in the real world.

Maps are no longer browsed – LLMs/agents use them to reason and act. 20M+ apps/websites, up to 40% of search queries, and 20% of LLM prompts need local context. 
10-15 attributes per place are not enough for AI. Places change constantly - restaurants close, hours change, businesses move. LLMs struggle with semantic queries “Specialty coffee shops in SF with Wi-Fi, popular with YC founders”. Agents cannot reliably “parse half the internet” - they need real-world ontology

We’re experienced builders in maps, search, and ML to solve this. Vlad knows this space inside and out – he worked on the Google Maps APIs GTM, plus firsthand customer experience from building in ridesharing and travel. Yarik has spent over a decade leading ML/search teams at Apple, Google, and Meta. 

Google Places alone is a $XXB/Yr monopoly. Agents turn it into a transactional layer opportunity for local commerce and ads.
one_liner: Real-world place intelligence for AI apps and agents

name: Poth Labs
long_description: Poth is an agentic research platform that connects to your company data, creates hypotheses about what might be causing problems, and validates them using both existing data and adaptive user feedback.
one_liner: Helping companies understand why users behave the way they do

name: SpotPay
long_description: SpotPay is a global borderless neobank. We give users one account that works for everything payments related: receiving money from abroad, paying locally, spending anywhere with the SpotPay card and saving and earning on their balance.
one_liner: Stablecoin Global Bank Account

name: Khotan (formerly Pollinate)
long_description:
Khotan is the platform for embedded forward-deployed engineers to rebuild critical operations as software and maintain them. It combines business context with the infrastructure agent harnesses need to deploy, share, and maintain each application.

Across procurement, supply chain, finance, and operations, we’ve rebuilt the workflows businesses cannot afford to get wrong, from procurement to back office operations.

Learn more at khotan.com
one_liner: FDE as a platform for rebuilding critical operations in software.

name: Polymorph
long_description:
Team has extensive startup, AI, and math backgrounds: 
- founding engineer at a unicorn
- ML infrastructure @ Scale AI (inference), AWS Bedrock (fine-tuning)
- ads engineering @ Meta & Twitch
- IMO & IOI medalists
one_liner: Building secure polymorphic apps

name: Ritivel
long_description:
Ritivel is an AI-native workspace for regulatory and medical writing teams at life sciences companies. Our AI agents draft CTDs, CSRs, INDs, and BLAs in minutes instead of weeks, helping drugs reach patients faster.

Every month a drug is delayed from reaching the market costs pharma companies ~$45M in lost revenue and more importantly, delays treatment for thousands of patients who need it. Yet regulatory teams are stuck in a painful, months-long process: synthesizing thousands of pages of clinical data, hunting through SharePoint folders for the right documents, chasing colleagues for missing inputs, and manually drafting submissions.

Ritivel deploys AI agents that transform how regulatory teams work. Our agents generate comprehensive first drafts directly in Microsoft Word, following FDA formatting requirements and pulling from your existing clinical data and prior submissions. Every data point includes citations linked back to the original source, so reviewers can verify with one click. Connected to SharePoint and Veeva, our agents automatically source the right documents. Integrated with Outlook, they handle reminder emails and follow-ups automatically.

We're engineers who previously built AI copilots at Microsoft Research. After 50+ conversations with pharma professionals, we discovered the critical bottleneck in regulatory submissions and built Ritivel to solve it.
one_liner: AI-native platform for Life-Sciences Documentation

name: Dipole Labs
one_liner: AI-controlled optical switching for AI clusters

name: Zymbly
one_liner: The decision-support layer for aviation ops teams to know what to do…

name: Regbase
one_liner: Automating Corporate Compliance, Worldwide

name: Rubric AI
long_description: Rubric AI (backed by Y Combinator) is the reasoning and verification infrastructure for AI. We're building the human and computational layer that turns expert judgment into training signals for the world's most consequential AI systems.
one_liner: Reasoning and verification infra for AI

name: Ossus
long_description:
We build intelligence for cultural institutions.

Our first commercial product is for the literature industry with a focus on school and public libraries. It is a AI-native OS for libraries, that helps librarians save time on tedious tasks and lets them focus on their patrons.
one_liner: Intelligence for cultural institutions

name: Origami Robotics
long_description: We are building a "manipulate anything" model with the robot hardware that embodies it. We designed a hand-based data-collection device and a high DOF, direct drive robotic hand that match each other exactly, enabling us to eliminate embodiment gap and collect real-world data and deploy it directly. We want to scale real world manipulation data by deploying our devices "in the wild" like manufacturing factories, logistic centers to collect Tesla like data, use these data to train our model and then provide automation solutions to these industries.
one_liner: Manipulate Anything Robot

name: Brumby (Formerly GrazeMate)
long_description:
Brumby builds autonomous drones that herd cattle.

On command, our drones fly to a paddock, position themselves around the mob, and move them where they need to go. What used to take a full day of helicopters, motorbikes, and horses now runs on a schedule.

We work with some of the largest cattle ranches in the world. While the drones are herding, they're also estimating animal weights, measuring grass biomass, monitoring water levels, and flagging sick animals. We're building physical AI that lets a grazier manage thousands of head across millions of acres from their phone.
one_liner: Robot Cowboys that Herd Cattle with AI Drones

name: DAIVIN!
long_description: DAIVIN! builds tankless dive gear that unlocks breath autonomy in extreme environments. Starting from underwater environment our mission is to remove the need for dangerous, heavy and bulky oxygen tanks in space, air and on land and replace them with water!
one_liner: Tankless Dive Gear - Breath Autonomy at Sea, Land & Space

name: Fixture
long_description: Fixture is an AI-native CRM built for startups. It integrates with all the tools you use to communicate with customers, tracks marketing channels (e.g. website traffic), and pulls everything into a single go-to-market context store. Our AI agents proactively help you move your deals forward, and you can use Fixture from our web UI or any of your favorite AI tools (e.g. Claude Code).
one_liner: An AI-first CRM built for Startups

name: Aurorin CAD
long_description:
There are 2 problems:

The first, CAD software is slow and the second, designing with it is a tedious process with many steps. Aurorin solves both of these problems by being a CAD software built from the ground up on a modern tech stack with AI at its heart.

Building the CAD kernel lets us fully leverage AI while modernizing execution speed. Almost all existing CAD software (Solidworks, NX, Creo, Catia, Fusion 360, Onshape etc) use the same couple of underlying CAD kernels built in the 80's. It's common for these programs to take 4 hours to open a file.

Aurorin uses a custom parametric and B-Rep driven CAD Kernel built to take full advantage of modern CPUs and GPUs and be AI native.
one_liner: Claude code for Mechanical Engineers

name: Bloom
long_description:
Bloom is the brand layer for agents - it turns brand into infrastructure that any agent, app, or platform can call.

Ingest your brand from anywhere - decks, websites, social, Figma, and more.
Bloom systemises your brand, enabling the creation of on-brand outputs like images, video, video, copy, and more, through the web app, the API, or MCP.

We're building brand-as-infrastructure for the AI era.
one_liner: The brand layer for agents.

name: Dispatch
long_description:
Dispatch is building refurbishable reentry vehicles that host and return payloads for companies making ultra-high-value materials (semiconductors, biotech, and pharma) that can only be manufactured in space. Right now, these companies have no practical way to manufacture and get their products back to Earth. We solve this bottleneck.

We just returned from the Mojave Desert testing our first full-scale reentry heat shield designed to protect the satellite as it returns from space at Mach 20+, built in an apartment for 100x cheaper than competitors. To test, we held it behind a rocket engine to simulate the forces of atmospheric reentry. IT WORKED! Watch here - https://youtu.be/dhlQmnIoptg

To scale, we anchor permanent infrastructure in orbit - building high power Autonomous Space Stations designed from day one for "lights-out" manufacturing serviced by the reentry vehicles.
one_liner: Satellites for Manufacturing in Space

name: Carrot Labs
long_description:
The problem: 
AI has quietly become one of the largest and fastest-growing line items for companies. Spend is scattered across a dozen provider consoles that each show one number at the end of the month and nothing about why it moved. There's no unified view, and no way to trace a dollar back to the customer, feature, team, or even the pull request that caused it.

Which customers are unprofitable once you subtract their AI costs? Which feature is quietly burning your Anthropic budget? Is this week's spike a runaway loop or real growth? How much did that AI-written PR actually cost to ship?
Today teams reverse-engineer answers by exporting CSVs from each provider and stitching them together in a spreadsheet, and by the time they do, the money is already spent.

What SuperPenguin does: SuperPenguin tracks AI spend across 14 providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, AWS Bedrock, Azure, Modal, Cursor, OpenRouter, and more).

* Zero-code setup: connect an API key and costs sync automatically with model-level breakdowns, trends, and forecasts
* Per-request attribution: add two lines with our Python or TypeScript SDK to tag every AI call by customer, feature, team, or environment (or any other metadata).
* AI coding cost per PR: connect Cursor to see engineering spend attributed to each pull request, repo, and developer, so you know what it actually costs to ship.
* Alerts on budget thresholds and spend anomalies, delivered to Slack, email, or Discord.

Most teams are set up in under five minutes. We help companies see where their AI money goes and whether it's worth it.
one_liner: AI Cost Management: Track and attribute AI spend across every provider

name: Unifold
long_description:
Launch crypto deposits in minutes. 

Unifold is a developer-first API + SDK that makes it easy for any app to accept on-chain deposits – across any chain and token – with less than 10 lines of code. We handle the full deposit flow so teams can ship faster and give users a smooth experience that actually works.

If you’re building a consumer-facing on-chain product and want best-in-class deposits (or want to support more chains fast), we’d love to work with you.
one_liner: Multi-chain deposit and payment infrastructure

name: Applied Electrodynamics, Inc.
long_description: Applied Electrodynamics builds imaging systems that see through solid matter. Our team previously co-invented the iPhone touchscreen and Nest learning thermostat. We’re starting in construction, helping teams map structural elements and utilities inside walls and ceilings. The same platform extends to security screening and cargo inspection. Our mission is to make the hidden physical world machine-readable across the entire electromagnetic spectrum.
one_liner: A new kind of camera that can see through walls.

name: Wayco
long_description: Wayco is building a unified data intelligence layer for medical treatment of legal cases. From the first intake to instant settlement.
one_liner: AI operator for medlegal cases

name: Shofo
long_description:
We are building the world’s largest video library. We've aggregated billions of videos into a searchable index and use agents to find and label the exact datasets a lab needs on demand.

If a lab needs 100K hours of cooking videos where someone is holding a pan, with reasoning annotations on top, our agents search the index, extract the matching subset, route it through our labeling pipeline, and deliver a custom dataset in days, not months.
one_liner: The World's Largest Video Library

name: OpenVector
long_description: OpenVector transforms any existing camera into an automated 24/7 workforce without requiring new hardware. Users simply describe a task in plain English, and OpenVector automatically builds a custom AI vision model to monitor the feed. When it detects an important physical event—like a stalled production cycle, a safety violation, or a waiting customer—it operates a computer just like a human to take immediate action. It integrates with legacy systems to make calls, send emails, update a POS/CRM, or trigger webhooks in real time. OpenVector enables any camera to do real work.
one_liner: AI that turns any camera to an autonomous worker with real-time vision

name: Remix
long_description:
Remix is the easiest way to create content with AI. Connect your accounts, drop in photos, voice notes, or messages, and Remix instantly creates posts in your style: articles, tweets, carousels, short-form videos, even content riffing on the latest trending formats. Chat with 100s of parallel AI agents that handle everything from picking your best photos to writing copy to applying edits, all at once.

Instagram was the easiest way to create photos on mobile. Remix is the easiest way to create everything else. Try it for yourself. Download the app and we'll instantly generate content from your LinkedIn and Twitter.
one_liner: Social media content auto-generated with your existing data

name: Condor Energy
long_description:
Condor helps large electricity consumers - C&I and data centers - cut electricity costs by helping the grid.
We are former electricity traders and energy physicists. We build an AI-powered software that our clients use to optimize their energy procurement - making sure they always have access to cheap & reliable power.
one_liner: Software for enterprise energy procurement.

name: Litmus
long_description: Litmus is the most accurate read on how an engineer actually builds. We evaluate candidates through async technical assessments built from your own tech context (repos, tickets, and job descriptions), generated from scratch and scoped as real end-to-end features. Candidates work in their own setup with all their tools including AI, while we track and evaluate their process and output. Every submission runs in a sandbox, and grading is tuned to your company across tool fluency, process, and outcome. You get a real read on how someone actually builds, not just how they interview.
one_liner: Run an async work trial on every engineer you interview.

name: Martini
long_description:
Martini is a collaborative, AI-native platform for professional filmmaking in the era of generative media.
By integrating the best generative models into professional workflows, we enable world-class creatives to harness generative AI as a legitimate medium for film.
one_liner: AI Video Production for Professionals

name: Wideframe
long_description:
Wideframe is an AI coworker for video editors. It automates the searching, labeling, organizing, and sequencing of footage so editors can ship videos faster.

Why is this important? Well, it turns out that editors spend 3x more time preparing footage than actually editing.

One agency said we will save their editors 10 hours per week. Another organized an entire documentary worth of footage in hours rather than weeks. He had 2,500+ videos, 500+ audio clips, across >2.5 TB of files and our agent handled them effortlessly.

Users link footage to Wideframe and then our Agent acts like an Assistant Editor to handle work like searching, labeling, organizing, and sequencing footage. Wideframe works with footage across local filesystems and cloud providers. We also supports Adobe Premiere Pro (.prproj) roundtrip. Our robust integrations are important so that Wideframe can work with source footage all the way through to delivering Premiere Pro projects to editors.
one_liner: AI coworker for video editors to ship more video faster

name: Cardinal
long_description:
Hey YC! We're Devi and Jianna - the founders of Cardinal.

Hey guys! We’re launching Cardinal publicly today - co’s like Mintlify, Deepgram, Giga, etc. use us to build revenue agents & design how they sell. 

The Problem

“Spray and Pray” outbound is dead. The best teams at outbound do it with extreme precision. Finding things in common with your customers, staying in touch with them through their content, mapping inbound from signups and ads, tracking website visitors, monitoring various signals, etc. This sounds great in theory, but in reality involves stringing together 10+ tools and hiring a GTM engineer.

That’s where Cardinal comes in.

Cardinal is an AI platform for precision outbound. Our agents can create workflows that normally require the work of fulltime GTM engineers.

If you're a founder or sales leader looking to bring AI into your sales org, would love to chat!
one_liner: Revenue Agents for GTM teams

name: Hedge
long_description: Hedge is an AI-Native specialty insurance company. We help insurance brokers find faster, cheaper, and better coverage for their customers.
one_liner: AI-Native insurance company

name: Surtr Defense Systems
long_description: Surtr builds ParallaxOS, the open operating system for counter-UAS. It takes sensor data from any radar, RF detector, camera, or acoustic array and fuses it into a single unified picture with AI-driven threat classification and engagement recommendations. One interface, any hardware, human in the loop.
one_liner: The hardware-agnostic operating system for drone defense

name: Klarify
long_description:
Klarify handles every job a therapist does other than the therapy itself, from clinical notes and treatment plans to insurance claims and finding new clients.

Therapists hold the world together. They also run businesses, file insurance claims, write letters, fill forms, supervise new grads, and do hours of paperwork every night. 

Practice management software has existed for decades. It records what therapists do. It can't actually do any of it.

Klara is the AI at the heart of Klarify. She handles notes, treatment plans, clinical letters, insurance claims, between-session resources, supervision prep, and finding new clients.

Nearly 8,300 therapists use Klarify today.

Our mission is to empower therapists, not replace them. So they can focus on the one thing only a human can do. Be present with their client.
one_liner: AI Agent for Therapists

name: afterfive
long_description: As the nature of work and society continually make it harder for the younger generation to make lasting connections, afterfive is building offline events, and eventually spaces, for irl human interaction.
one_liner: Life starts after five.

name: primitive
long_description: Building the communication infrastructure needed for fully autonomous agents
one_liner: communication for agents

name: Standard Signal
long_description: Standard Signal is the first hedge fund that researches and executes trades purely with AI. Our custom models discover and trade on new fundamental truths about the world before humans can.
one_liner: Hedge fund where AI researches and executes every trade end-to-end

name: Stage
long_description:
Stage is a new code review platform designed to help engineers better understand and review AI generated code.

Engineering teams are shipping faster than ever with agents, but now they’re drowning in an endless backlog of PRs to review. Stage reorganizes the code review process around how engineers naturally think, enabling you to review (and merge!) PRs 5x faster. 

Used by top engineers at Legora, n8n, Branch, and more.
one_liner: Code review platform for humans and agents

name: PerfectBit, Inc.
long_description: We create a new kind of data for training AI models. Most LLMs are pre-trained on noisy web-scraped text, but they hallucinate and still fail on tasks that humans find trivial.  PerfectBit creates high-quality training data that's correct by construction. We verify against physics simulators, scientific databases, formal proof systems. LLMs, robotics, AI for Science, and more.
one_liner: Correct by construction AI training data

name: Memoir
long_description:
Memoir turns what your team ships into marketing material. It connects to GitHub, Linear, Slack, customer feedback, and product analytics to understand what changed, why it matters, who should hear about it, and how to tell the story.

From there, Memoir creates multi-touchpoint marketing across social, blogs, changelogs, demo videos, customer updates, and launch content, all in your company’s voice. It also watches what is getting traction in your market, learns from your edits and campaign performance, and gets better every time you ship.

It is not a generic AI content tool. Memoir is a marketer with the soul of an engineer: it starts from the product source of truth and turns product velocity into market velocity.
one_liner: Marketing campaigns from everything your team ships

name: Illume Labs
long_description: Illume is a 24/7 AI personal health & longevity companion that connects your wearables, blood panels, and genomic data to text you personalized and actionable insights. We pull in your health data and fuse it into one secure model. You get daily text updates on what changed, what it means, and what to do next; conversational health Q&A like "What should I do to improve my bloodwork?"; cross-data trend detection that catches patterns individual platforms miss; and a full platform to dig deeper, explore your health data, and text your Illume agent anytime. We're 3 MIT grads & friends, with experience at Windsurf, MIT CSAIL, Eli Lilly, & the Broad Institute.
one_liner: 24/7 Personal Health & Longevity Companion

name: Instance
long_description:
We’re automating robot evaluation– the loop where you wait for your robot to roll out, judge its success, and then reset the scene. We're starting with step one: a success detector that automatically tells you whether your robot actually completed its task along with detailed subtask breakdown. 

We're MIT computer scientists & friends since middle school, with backgrounds at NASA JPL, SpaceX, and AWS.

Book a demo with founders@instancelabs.ai.
one_liner: Automated evals for robot policies

name: Osmaura
long_description:
Our agents scan the web to deliver new client & cross-selling opportunities for law firm partners.

Every day, our customers log onto our platform to see who to contact, why now, and what to say.

Partners are trained to practice law - not to prospect, sell, and manage pipelines. We're here to help them grow while they focus on what they do best.
one_liner: AI growth engine for law firms.

name: Multiplier
long_description:
Multiplier helps institutional investors research stocks and manage their portfolios. We're live with six hedge funds, and our users spend 4+ hours a day in the platform.

Investors who try "nearly every tool on the market," to quote a client of ours, "wind up with an unwieldy collection of fragmented point solutions." Those who focus on building a great setup with general agents are instead "signing up for a full-time job." So we deploy a platform called Multiplier that unifies structured data, unstructured data, AI work, human work, and tacit firm knowledge in one secure, governed, customized application.

Our first vertical: independent equity funds with $250M-$5B of assets. They know AI is essential for staying relevant, but they don't have the time or talent to figure out what to do about it. But once we deploy Multiplier––"We used to spend 80% of our time gathering information and 20% of our time acting on it," said one customer. "Multiplier has flipped those percentages."
one_liner: Agent harnesses for asset managers

name: Totalis
one_liner: derivative layer for prediction markets

name: Replicas
long_description:
Replicas is a background coding agent that allows you to delegate tasks to Claude Code or Codex from Slack, Linear, GitHub, and more. Each task works inside of a sandboxed virtual machine, allowing teams to heavily parallelize work and burn through tickets.

Replicas agents output higher quality PRs via feedback loops - each task automatically is notified and fixes CI failures and reads all code reviews. With Environments, engineering teams can configure agents to run their entire codebase locally, verify its work, and provide preview URLs.
one_liner: Run any coding agent harness in the cloud

name: Rudus
long_description: Rudus is an AI-powered takeoff and estimation platform enabling concrete contractors to win 3x more projects yearly. It automatically identifies every concrete structure like footings, walls, columns, and slabs on plans, eliminating the manual work and reducing estimation time by 70%. Concrete is the most-used material on earth after water, and demand is surging with the AI infrastructure boom.
one_liner: AI Takeoffs for Concrete

name: Palette
long_description: Palette is an AI-native media platform built by MIT computer scientists and multimodal researchers that unifies the creative workflow into a single generation engine. We eliminate tool and context fragmentation for creative teams in enterprises and allow content creators to transform static assets into controllable, repeatable workflows in one conversation.
one_liner: An AI-Native Media Platform

name: Hexa
long_description: Hexa helps industrial distributors automate their sales and procurement workflows to quote faster and win more bids.
one_liner: Autonomous operations for industrial distributors

name: Scope
long_description:
Scope is the system companies use to measure and improve how agents discover, interact and use their product.

As more products gets used through AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar agents, agents are starting to influence which tools get chosen, how they get set up, and whether they keep getting used. Most companies still cannot see that process clearly.

We run real workflows across agents and show teams when the agent picks them versus a competitor, where it breaks, where docs or product surfaces confuse the agent, and what to change to get better results and a better agent experience.

I started Scope after working on interpretability research for closed-source models at Princeton and later as an ML engineer in GEO/AEO. I kept seeing the same pattern: these systems were shaping real product discovery and usage, but companies had very little visibility into what the model was actually doing.

We are starting with products that agents can directly interact with, especially APIs, infra products, CLIs, and MCP servers.
one_liner: We help software companies get discovered and used by AI agents

name: Marker
long_description: Marker embeds with companies, learns how their organization actually works, finds the highest-impact problems, and ships custom AI agents into production in weeks via the Marker Command Center. Each agent deepens our understanding, so the next one launches faster.
one_liner: AI-native consultancy rebuilding businesses with agents

name: Twolabs
long_description:
We build modular humanoid robots and the software platform that allows anyone to train, deploy, and scale robots for real-world tasks.

Today, teaching a robot a new skill requires robotics engineers, machine learning engineers, training infrastructure, and significant compute resources. We reduce that process to:
Record → Upload → Train → Deploy.

Our robots are modular and configurable, with interchangeable end effectors, configurable sensors, and multiple deployment configurations. 

We believe current humanoid embodiments are often overfit for specific use cases, so we're building a platform that adapts to different environments and applications.

Long term, we want robotics to be as accessible as software development. Our goal is to become the default platform for training and deploying autonomous robots.
one_liner: Humanoid robot platform for builders.

name: Lightsprint
long_description:
Lightsprint is a collaborative platform for software teams to plan visually, preview live and ship with an army of cloud agents. Your whole team, including non-engineers, can now ship end to end reliably.

The company is founded by Ben Ong, an AI investor who previously scaled AI products at SEA Group (NYSE: SE) and Temasek ($300B fund), Benedict Chan who was VP Engineering at Chainlink and CTO at BitGo (NYSE:BTGO), and Heng Hong Lee who built Facebook Messenger in 2013 and was Director of Engineering at Fazz (YC S17).
one_liner: Collaborative product development with cloud agents

name: Discovered Materials
long_description:
We use AI to discover new materials for the semiconductor industry - specifically datacenters and fabs. Finding novel materials today takes 10+ years of lab work. We aim to compress that timeline to months, using a swarm of AI agents.

Akash completed his PhD at Stanford on material discovery for semiconductors. The materials he discovered for nanoscale interconnects have been adopted into the roadmaps of Intel and TSMC. Advaith was the founding applied scientist at Persona AI (acquired by Luma Labs), where he built long horizon autonomous agents for major telecom and crypto companies.

Power consumption and heat release from AI chips is doubling every year. The semiconductor industry needs new materials to keep this exponential going -  Discovered Materials will help find them.
one_liner: AI scientists to discover materials for the semiconductor industry.

name: Saffron
long_description:
Saffron allows companies to quickly evaluate how well software engineers use AI to code. 

The way engineers write code has fundamentally changed, but the way companies evaluate them hasn't. Saffron gives teams full visibility into how candidates use AI agents to build, debug, and ship real features on an actual codebase. 

Saffron was founded by Robert Chondro (formerly MIT and Jane Street), Jerry Yao (Stanford and Jane Street), and Kazuma Choji (Harvey Mudd, published in NeurIPS and ICML), and is backed by Y Combinator (P26) and Afore Capital.
one_liner: Helping your company find 10x engineers.

name: Chert
long_description: Chert provides the infrastructure for businesses to automate conversations over iMessage. We’re already working with B2C startups, customer experience teams, and sales teams to reach end users through trusted and conversational messaging.
one_liner: iMessage infrastructure for business

name: Incandor
long_description: Incandor detects fraud on banking and fintech platforms by learning how every user physically behaves — mouse dynamics, keystroke timing, scroll patterns, and on mobile, how they hold their phone. Founded by two Stanford engineers and backed by Y Combinator, Incandor builds a behavioral map of every user on your platform — no fraud labels or historical data required. At the individual level, it identifies account takeovers with >99% accuracy. At the population level, coordinated rings, mule operators, and coerced sessions separate out naturally. Rather than a black-box risk score, fraud teams query the map via a programmable API.
one_liner: Behavioral intelligence infrastructure for anti-fraud

name: Nine Fives
long_description: Nine Fives produces modern radio frequency test equipment and solutions to disrupt the $130B test equipment industry. By combining modern electronics, AI ready test automation, and strategic supply chains, we’re equipping our customers to cut their time to market in half.
one_liner: RF test equipment for next-gen spacecraft, drones, and cellphones

name: Andustry
long_description: Andustry is an AI-native hardware lab.

name: Zenbu
long_description: Zenbu is an extensible IDE for orchestrating coding agents. Shape it around exactly how you and your team work.
one_liner: The extensible IDE for coding agents

name: InLoop Robotics
long_description:
We are building AI-native fulfillment powered by robotics.
Warehouses without human labor that get better, faster, and cheaper with every order.

Most robotics companies wait until their system is perfect before deploying. We don't. We ship imperfect policies into real warehouses, detect failures in real time, recover automatically when we can, and bring in a remote human operator when we can't.

Every failure becomes training data. Every intervention makes the system better. The result is a fulfillment system that continuously learns from production.
one_liner: Robotic arms that pick and pack your orders.

name: Dayjob
long_description: Dayjob does AI Scheduling for Short Haul Trucks. Our scheduling agent plugs into existing ERPs and continuously re-optimises routes in real time - handling new jobs, driver changes, and exceptions automatically. Customers in waste management see 8%+ efficiency gains from day one.
one_liner: AI Scheduling for Short Haul Trucks

name: The Company Company
long_description: The Company Company builds the agent and the infrastructure to run companies.
one_liner: The last agent your company will ever need.

name: Trellis
long_description:
Trellis is building toward a new hospitality platform: one that does not just help guests find homes, but actually operates them with agents. 

Our first wedge is short-term rental property managers, replacing their fragmented stack across guest messages, tasks, cleaners, maintenance, vendors, and owner updates with agents that run operations end-to-end. 

In two months, we’ve grown to $500k ARR across 35 customers and 3000 listings, growing around 15% week over week, with one customer already running day-to-day operations with no human involved.
one_liner: Agents that run short-term rental operations end-to-end

name: Atrisa
long_description: AI Agents to build, debug and automate analog circuit design
one_liner: AI Agents for Analog Circuit Design

name: Tenet Industries
long_description:
Tenet Industries is building low-cost mass-producible defense systems, starting with attack drones.

We're using design-for-manufacturing and first principles to reimagine how a defense product is developed and manufactured. We begin with the manufacturing, then solve all the inefficiencies and difficulties in the firmware/software. This allows us to hyperscale production in multiple defense categories such as strike drones, loitering munitions, jammers, radars, etc.

Our first product is a kamikaze quadcopter. It assembles in two minutes and has half the parts to comparable systems.
one_liner: Low-cost, mass-producible defense systems

name: Hub
long_description: Hub is a multimodal lab providing real world data to frontier labs and robotic companies.
one_liner: Real-world training data for frontier AI labs and robotics.

name: Light Anchor
long_description:
Light Anchor (YC P26) builds AI-run consumer brands that run at the speed of compute. 

Consumer brands have always been limited by the speed of humans: hiring, coordinating, and sleeping. AI agents that now run operations end-to-end break all those constraints, making a new kind of consumer business possible: one capped by compute, not headcount.

Today, Light Anchor operates one flagship brand and multiple experiment stores, all run by AI agents on a shared platform that compounds with every new brand launched. The vision is thousands of consumer businesses, operating with little to no human intervention.
one_liner: AI-run consumer brands

name: Limrun
long_description:
Coding agents in the cloud don't work for majority of teams who require native capabilities; they lack XCode for iOS, Emulator for Android, Unity for game development teams. We are on a mission to cloudify every local development utility so that regardless of where it runs, your agent can compose an ideal set of capabilities on the fly so you don't need to run it on your laptop.

Today, we provide remote services such as XCode, iOS & Android simulators to enable coding agents running in any sandbox to be able to build and iterate over mobile apps, too.

Replit, Rork, Momentic, Minitap and more agent companies have built mobile development and testing experiences on Limrun platform. Coconote (Quizlet), SorceJobs (W25) and more companies with mobile apps use Limrun with their cloud agents, merging PRs without having to check out the code locally.
one_liner: Extend cloud sandboxes with iOS, Android and more

name: GodHands
long_description: GodHands is building a living knowledge base for engineering teams, turning the code, docs, and decisions across your stack into a single source of truth that stays accurate as you grow.
one_liner: The company knowledge base that updates itself

name: Superlog
long_description:
Sentry and Datadog dump a stream of alerts. Most are duplicates, most lack context, and you still have to solve the issue yourself.

Superlog is AI-native observability that's meant not to be opened. A wizard scans your repo and installs proper OpenTelemetry instrumentation, then runs daily to keep up as you ship new code. When something breaks, Superlog groups the errors into a single incident, investigates with full context (logs, traces, recent deploys, past Slack threads), and posts one mergeable PR in Slack. You merge it, ignore it, or open it as a Claude Code session and modify it.

Telemetry is vendor-neutral, so you keep every log, trace, and metric we install, even if you leave.
one_liner: Make software self-healing

name: GovGuard
long_description:
GovGuard is building AI agents that automate government workflows, starting with FOIA requests.

Today, public records teams still spend hours searching for responsive records and applying redactions. Many offices still redact sensitive information line by line with a sharpie. Local governments spend billions processing these requests, and if a city misses a legal deadline, it can be sued for failing to comply with public records law.
one_liner: Automating Government Workflows, starting with FOIA

name: Kinro
long_description:
We are building the first autonomous insurance brokerage.

We hit $1M in annual revenue building insurance workflows for brokers. Then we realized the bigger opportunity was replacing them.

In the US, there are 36 million SMBs, and 77% are underinsured because distribution is broken. Brokers can’t serve low-premium SMBs profitably: a $2K policy takes almost as much work as a $20K one.

Kinro changes that. Our AI agents handle the full broker workflow 24/7, from finding prospects to binding policies.

In 3 weeks, we got licensed in 24 states and appointed by 10 carriers. Last week, our agents autonomously bound 9 policies.

Before Kinro, Pierre was an AI researcher at DeepMind. Corentin was Chief Insurance Officer at an insurtech. Parth built ML systems at Zoox.
one_liner: Autonomous insurance brokerage for small businesses

name: Juno
long_description:
Juno is an AI personal health assistant for the 1B+ people living with chronic illness.

Launched in October, Juno now supports 150,000+ patients globally.
one_liner: AI Health Assistant for Chronic Illness

name: Zolvo
long_description: Commercial lenders manage billions in assets on legacy software and manual workflows, their systems live on people’s heads like its the 90s. Zolvo replaces the entire back office with AI: automated data ingestion, invoice reconciliation, collections outreach, and funder monitoring. Our clients go live in weeks and eliminate hours of daily manual work per operator, allowing teams to only handle exceptions. We're building the future of commercial lending.
one_liner: AI Back-Office Automation for Commercial Lenders

name: Interfaze
long_description:
Interfaze is an AI model built on a new architecture that merges specialized DNN/CNN models with transformers for tasks that require deterministic output and high consistency like Document intelligence, Object detection, Classification, Audio understanding and more.

Interfaze outperforms large lab models like Gemini flash, Claude Sonnet and the GPT-5.4 mini series

Architecture paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04101
Full open benchmarks: https://interfaze.ai/leaderboards
one_liner: AI model built for high accuracy deterministic tasks

name: Elyra
long_description:
Elyra is an AI reservation system for restaurants. Instead of missing 40% of incoming phone calls and taking days to reply to emails, leaving over $100,000 in bookings on the table every year, restaurants get AI agents that answer every call and email instantly, 24/7, connected to a reservation system that optimizes table placements in real time so empty seats get filled with the right guests.

Felix and Alan met in primary school in Stockholm and have been building things together ever since.

We launched with a single restaurant and within weeks they hit record occupancy, bookings they used to miss were suddenly being captured automatically, and empty Tuesday nights started filling up. Today we power top restaurants groups. 

There are over 1 million restaurants in the US and Europe alone. The average restaurant loses $100K+ a year to missed calls and slow email replies. At our current pricing, that's a $10B+ market opportunity, and we're the only system that handles the call, the email, and the table allocation in one place.
one_liner: AI Reservation System for Restaurants

name: Wealor
one_liner: AI-native platform for wealth managers

name: HEVN, inc
long_description:
HEVN is a platform where companies can open business accounts with sponsor banks across the US, Europe, the UAE, Latin America, and Puerto Rico, and then move money between those accounts using stablecoin rails in minutes. 

It's a faster and more efficient alternative to SWIFT for international businesses that care a lot about speed of transaction and speed of complience checks. We're using AI to automate routine payments, paperwork and RFIs and minimise the losses that companies incur on stuck international wires.
one_liner: Global bank account for exporters

name: KelAI
long_description:
Founded by former WorldQuant portfolio manager & head of event driven systematic strategies Jeremie Cohen, KelAI is building the autonomous alpha engine for hedge funds, traders and institutional investors. 

Investment teams now have more data, tools and compute than ever, but research still runs across siloed systems and inefficient workflows. KelAI turns that fragmented process into a compounding AI-native engine that continuously finds, tests and validates trading signals at a pace no human team can match.
one_liner: The AI Quant: Autonomous Alpha Engine for Funds and Traders.

name: Deep Interactions
long_description: Deep Interactions is a collaborative AI builder. We don't leave you with a spaghetti mess of a code. We bring product intelligence and power the context layer that enables your team to build in sync - saving companies tokens, time, and nerves. You give us a problem and we ship a working AI product in the same afternoon.
one_liner: Collaborative AI app builder for teams

name: qomplement
long_description:
qomplement is the agentic ERP for retail and logistics companies.

Retail and logistics are the industries with the highest volume of transactions in the world. POs, freight invoices, inventory updates, and shipment confirmations. Every single one still requires a person to process it manually. Their only solution has been hiring more people.

Legacy ERPs were built for humans. qomplement is the agentic ERP that cuts 95% of manual work and handles 100x more transactions with the same headcount. We give procurement and operations teams superpowers: automating purchase order intake, vendor onboarding, item master updates, freight order processing, carrier invoicing, three-way matching, and inventory reconciliation.

Headquartered in San Francisco.
one_liner: The Agentic ERP for supply chain operations

name: Pavoot
long_description:
Pavoot is an AI event manager for companies that run in-person customer events.

More and more companies are investing in dinners, summits, and community events because relationships drive revenue. But today, running events means sourcing attendees, sending invitations, hosting the event, and then manually digging through notes, emails, and spreadsheets afterward to figure out who attended, what was discussed, who is a strong lead, and who should be followed up with. Most teams either send generic "thanks for coming" emails or never properly capture the value created during the event.

Pavoot replaces this fragmented workflow with a single AI system that keeps every attendee, interaction, conversation, and follow-up connected in one place, making relationship-driven growth scalable.

Gohar and Ana met while studying Computer Science at ETH Zurich. Gohar is a six-time Swiss chess champion and was the youngest member of Switzerland’s national chess team at age 13. Ana won more than 20 medals in scientific Olympiads, ranked 1st in CS at Latin America’s most competitive university, and built internal AI systems used by hundreds of data scientists at some of the largest banks in Latin America before moving to ETH Zurich for AI research.

===

Book a demo: pavoot.com
one_liner: AI Event Manager for in-person events

name: Madrone
long_description: Madrone builds cooling systems for data centers. In Texas, where most new sites are, Madrone can cool using 30% less power and water, thanks to novel dew-point cooling technology.
one_liner: Hyper-efficient coolers for data centers

name: shotwell.ai
long_description: Shotwell AI is building the data QA layer for dexterous robotics. We work with teams collecting teleoperation and egocentric data to provide dense semantic annotation and validate task adherence. This lets teams compress feedback loops from weeks to hours and iterate on models much faster.
one_liner: Annotations for robotics data

name: Standout
long_description:
Standout gives every talent and company an autonomous agent that represents them, assess the other side, and makes intros when it matters.

Why it matters? Because this is hiring today:
- Talent use AI to apply to 100s of jobs - this is spam.
- Founders/Recruiting send 100s of AI-generated messages to hire the same talent - this is spam.

This has to stop.

Talent stays fully anonymous until they accept an intro. The best way for passively exploring the market and not missing a life changing opportunity.

In 1 month, 10k talent / 60 companies / 100 intros.
one_liner: Agentic hiring marketplace

name: transload
long_description:
transload helps logistics companies measure shipments using the security cameras they already have. A pallet, a couch, a tire – we capture its true size as it moves through the warehouse.

For our customers, 15% of shipments turn out to be bigger than what the sender claimed. Catching those differences is worth ~$50k per site per month in rebillings and improved trailer utilization.
one_liner: Measure freight with security cameras

name: Userlens
long_description:
Companies today are growing faster than ever with smaller teams. We are making it possible for these lean, AI-native companies to manage enterprise deals. 

Userlens is building the AI customer success manager. Our goal is to be the CSM for every customer at every company. 

Every $1-5M of new revenue requires another CSM hire. Userlens breaks that ceiling. Our agents research accounts, catch churn before it happens, and drive renewals and upsells like a top-tier CSM would. 

We're at $307K ARR, growing 127% month over month, with 30 customers including Smartly (300M ARR). Over 300 CSMs are on Userlens, and 76% of them use it weekly. 

Built by second-time founders who lived this problem at their last startup.
one_liner: Agents that renew and expand six and seven-figure enterprise software

name: Sherpa
long_description:
Sherpa automatically optimizes websites for every human and every agent. For humans, Sherpa studies visitor behavior, builds better pages and flows, tests them on live traffic, and keeps what converts. For AI agents, Sherpa tests different agent-facing versions of the site until agents recommend the company more often. 

Customers typically see a 15-20% lift in their primary conversion metric after using Sherpa for 30 days.
one_liner: Make websites improve themselves.

name: Salesgraph
long_description:
Salesgraph learns and automates 99% of the work that AEs do between calls with a dynamic context graph to give agents structure.

Research briefs, call gaps, follow ups, committee mapping, business cases, pricing calculators, anything that moves a deal forward. 

We’re now building the context graph to power our agents for early partners at Mintlify, Tex, and Strala.
one_liner: Proactive revenue agents that move enterprise deals forward

name: InstaAgent
long_description:
InstaAgent helps B2C companies scale a single campaign across hundreds of specific audiences on Meta and TikTok, each with its own content, voice, and targeting. Traction: $1M Ann. Run Rate in 10 months.

From one brief, we create personalized creatives, distribute them through paid channels and niche social accounts, and use performance data to learn what works, scale winners, and improve every campaign.
one_liner: Scale marketing campaigns across hundreds of personas

name: RentAHuman
one_liner: Marketplace for AI agents to hire humans.

name: Andco
long_description: Our agents retrieve and synthesize all the records law firms need to start a personal injury case. We get police reports, open insurance claims, and retrieve all the medical records and bills needed to build a case.
one_liner: Agents that build personal injury cases

name: Arga Labs
long_description:
We build environments to test your app and agents against the real world.

Deploy your code/agent into a sandbox that runs against replicas of external services (Stripe, Slack, Google Drive, etc.). Twins support the same APIs, MCP tool calls & SDKs as the real software, and you can spin up thousands of instances in parallel and seed them using natural language.
