They find property records like deeds, tax records, permits, parcel data, and MLS information, then use that data to fill out contracts, organize documents, track deadlines, and help brokerages close deals faster.

We are starting by automating transactions and will expand into other parts of brokerage operations. Much of the software used across the real estate industry is outdated. With today’s advances in AI, we can build agents that handle this operational work and create modern software around how brokerages actually work.

We currently sell to brokerages in New Hampshire and are expanding quickly.
one_liner: AI-native OS for Real Estate Brokerages
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

name: Buildbox
long_description: Buildbox helps product teams improve the human-agent experience. We analyze user intent, agent behavior, and outcomes to find where users get stuck or lose trust, then turn those findings into ranked, reproducible issues.
one_liner: Understand how users experience your AI agents

name: Riften
long_description:
Intelligence will be the most valuable asset a company owns. Today, almost every company rents it.

Companies pay a handful of labs one token at a time. Each dollar buys an answer, not an asset. They spend more, but own nothing more.

Riften reverses that.

Change one environment variable and Riften becomes the gateway for a company's AI traffic. We route each request to the lowest-cost model that can do the job, serving most work on open-weight models we host. Customers save money immediately without rebuilding their products.

The gateway is the entry point. Over time, Riften turns the company's work into private models built on open weights and shaped around the business. What begins as cheaper inference becomes an intelligence stack the company owns, runs on infrastructure it controls, and uses to power its most important applications.

We call this earned intelligence. It is created by the company's own work, controlled by the company, and accumulated over time.

The next generation of companies will not rent their intelligence. They will earn it, own it, and compound it. Riften is how they get there.
one_liner: Earned intelligence for every company

name: Bizmark
long_description:
Bizmark is the operating system for companies that make, move, or sell physical goods.

Legacy ERPs force operators into templates that don’t reflect how the business runs. As a result, decisions that directly affect revenue, margins, and service levels are made from spreadsheets, with less information than the company has, often by whoever is closest, not whoever knows best.

Bizmark solves this by connecting to the systems, inboxes, spreadsheets, documents, and the knowledge that lives in people’s heads, then turning that context into optimized decisions and automated workflows. Bizmark adapts to how each company operates, not the other way around. And customers get a working product in weeks, not years.

Some of the most innovative American companies use Bizmark to transform their operations.
one_liner: The OS for companies that make, move, or sell physical goods

name: Mosaic
long_description:
Mosaic's main product, Ocean, gives people and their coding agents shared memory across every session, so everyone can understand what happened, why decisions were made, and pick up where someone else left off.

We also built Mosaic, a real-time coding environment where multiple people and their agents can work together live. It went viral, defined the multiplayer AI category, and inspired frontier labs like Anthropic.

Together, we’re building the infrastructure for people and agents to share context and work together.
one_liner: Defining the frontier of multiplayer AI.

name: Dialogus
long_description:
Dialogus builds voice agent infrastructure for enterprises.

Most companies can demo an AI voice agent, but getting one into production is hard. Enterprise agents need to connect to phone systems, internal tools, databases, CRMs, messaging channels, human escalation flows, monitoring, and compliance processes.

Dialogus provides the infrastructure to deploy production-grade voice agents that don’t just talk but complete real workflows. Our platform lets enterprises launch agents that collect information, validate it against internal systems, update records, send follow-up messages, and escalate edge cases to humans.
one_liner: Infra for enterprise voice agents.

name: Alloovium
long_description: Alloovium is the document intelligence layer for construction 🏗️ It reads every document and piece of data on a project (contracts, specs, drawings, compliance records, conversations), turning them into answers you can trust and actions with real value: every answer cites its exact source sentence, paperwork is checked clause by clause against the builder's own Integrated Management System, and nothing AI-drafted moves without a human sign-off, with it all compliant by default.
one_liner: Construction paperwork that finally works for your team

name: MOCHI.TV
long_description: Mochi is a mobile-first entertainment platform for vertical anime shorts. Users can scroll to discover shows and binge bite-sized episodes, unlocking them with either coins or a subscription. We produce new shows daily with AI, and they've hit 300M+ views organically.
one_liner: 1 Minute Anime

name: DeepReach Inc.
long_description:
Physical AI — robots and world models — is bottlenecked on one thing: diverse,
real-world data at massive scale showing how humans actually do work in the
physical world. It was never written down, and you can't buy it, because no one
has ever captured it. Only real local experts, the people who do this work every
day, can produce data this authentic and valuable.

DeepReach builds the network that reaches them. We design and manufacture
wearable stereo capture devices, then place them with local data partners who
run collection as their own business — in warehouses, workshops, farms, kitchens
and repair shops. They own the local relationships; we supply the hardware, the
software platform, the quality pipeline and the payments. Anyone can run a data
business.

That structure is what produces diversity. Instead of thousands of hours inside
one environment, we deliver hours spread across thousands of environments —
which is what actually makes robot policies generalize.

475 devices in the field and 100+ data partners are live across 7 countries, adding new
partners every week. They've collected nearly 150,000 clips in the past three
months, with volume roughly doubling month over month. Our data is in production
with multiple frontier model and robotics companies, and we're scaling to
10,000+ devices across 50 countries.
one_liner: Real-world data network for robots & world models

name: COACH
long_description:
Coach is the AI sales coach for in-person sales teams.

Reps record every meeting, and our AI figures out what your best closers do differently, then coaches everyone else to do the same, with precise, personalized feedback after every meeting. 

Managers finally see 100% of what happens in the field: Coach flags who's stuck and why, so they only step in when it matters, and can coach 5× more reps.

And every meeting feeds one sales brain, so leadership finally gets answers to the questions that used to be guesswork. They finally see the game of their team not just the scoreboard.

Our bet: in the AI era, in-person sales will only matter more. It may end up being one of the last truly human jobs.

Our conviction: any motivated rep can become a great one, meeting after meeting.

The results so far: +32% average lift in conversion rate.

COΛCH, post-game video analysis for field sales reps. YC S26
one_liner: The AI Coach for in person sales reps.

name: Grocalo
one_liner: AI brain that runs content for creators

name: Audun
long_description: Audun automates debt collection.
one_liner: AI-native debt collection

name: Marble
long_description:
Marble is the first AI-native operating system for the restaurant back-of-house. 

Restaurants, cafes and bars still run on a patchwork of disconnected point solutions, spreadsheets, clipboards and tribal knowledge, which costs the industry billions each year in stockouts, food waste, and lost profit. 

Marble replaces that entire stack with one system. Computer vision and voice AI capture real-time inventory levels 90% faster than manual counts, ML models forecast item-level demand at 97% accuracy, and AI agents run dozens of end-to-end workflows autonomously, from procurement and invoice reconciliation to scheduling, food prep, menu engineering, and more.
one_liner: The autonomous back-of-house for restaurants.

name: Stoa
long_description: Stoa provides pricing and trading infrastructure for AI hardware, live with an RFQ marketplace where companies buy and sell GPUs through vetted dealers real-time.
one_liner: The market behind AI hardware.

name: Glen
long_description:
Glen is unified context for every agent and human on your team. Most MCP tools hand an agent a slice, one Slack thread, a single diff, and leave it to stitch the rest together itself. Glen reads from where your work already lives, code and PRs, issues, docs, and meetings, reconciles it, and gives your agents the full picture instead.

With Glen a coding agent knows why a line was written, not just what it says. Ask a PR assistant anything about a change and the clarifying-question relay disappears. Bug bots read the intent behind the code before they comment, so they stop flagging deliberate choices as defects and stop repeating mistakes they already made. A sales agent can coach your head of sales off the full account history, how teammates handle similar calls, what was promised, where the deal stalled, etc. 

As the work gets done, Glen also distills it into skills and offers them back to the next agent, or person, who hits the same task.
one_liner: Shared learning layer for agents

name: Context.dev
long_description:
Context.dev gives AI agents structured data from any website through a single API.

We help developers build smarter agents & products that depend on accurate, fresh web data.

If you need structured data from the internet, you need Context.dev

Proud to power agentic products at Mintlify, Super, Vizzy, Klarna, and 400+ other companies.
one_liner: We give AI agents realtime web context.

name: Standard Medical
long_description:
Standard Medical is building a primary care clinic where AI earns clinical autonomy. Physician attention is the scarcest resource in medicine, and nearly everything wrong with healthcare follows from that scarcity: the waitlists, the prices, the counties with no doctor at all. We are building the way out.

The clinic is designed for AI to do more than draft notes or recommend next steps. For defined clinical workflows, the AI progresses on the same principle used in medical training: supervised first, then progressively entrusted as it demonstrates competence, clearing safety and performance gates for each capability. We'll begin with prescription renewals and routine lab ordering and review, then expand into the rest of longitudinal primary care and common, low-acuity urgent care. Physicians set its scope, supervise its work, and take every complex or unusual case. Any authority the AI earns can be revoked if performance slips.

We're pursuing participation in Utah's first-in-nation AI regulatory sandbox to test this model and seek authorization under state oversight, as Washington moves to take clinical AI national. First patients: Utah, 2026. The model is built to repeat state by state. Long term, we want routine care to be increasingly autonomous, nearly free to deliver, and available whenever a patient needs it. The goal is one physician safely caring for a hundred times more patients, with the marginal cost of routine care driven toward zero.
one_liner: A primary care clinic where AI earns clinical autonomy

name: Codag
one_liner: Log compression for agents.

name: Exosat
long_description:
Exosat is building thousands of low-cost communication satellites to provide a neutral, sovereign alternative to Starlink. By designing our satellites with zero ITAR/EAR-controlled content, we can leverage manufacturers anywhere in the world to produce our satellites at under a tenth of the cost and launch them from other nations to bypass capacity bottlenecks and access equatorial orbits. 

We're starting off by selling connectivity to device OEMs and network operators, but will eventually use the distributed compute across our constellation to run low-latency inference for robots and autonomous vehicles in remote and rural areas anywhere on the planet.

We've already signed hundreds of millions in LOIs to work with operators across Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, booked our first satellite launch next year, and hold an 11,000 satellite filing with the ITU to build the largest comms network outside of the U.S. and China.
one_liner: Building a sovereign Starlink

name: Touchmark
long_description: Buy tokens over a time window from the provider of your choice at a price fixed today - 10-30% off the on-demand price. If your plans change - resell your reserved capacity to another buyer.
one_liner: Market for future inference capacity

name: Prodigy Research
long_description: Prodigy is the frontier AI trading research lab. We've trained the world's best foundation model for quantitative finance. We've already achieved more than 100% returns in live trading over the course of our YC batch, doubling our capital while major indices were flat. Our founders previously worked at Jane Street, trained frontier AI models at Google DeepMind and shipped cutting-edge AI at Apple to billions of customers. Join us as we use AI to solve the market.
one_liner: Training the world's best foundation model for quantitative finance.

name: Zaplar
long_description:
Zaplar is the AI-native operating system for hotels.

Hotels run on legacy software and a fragmented tech stack. Zaplar replaces the entire hotel tech stack (PMS, POS, booking engine, etc) with one software that can handle hotel operations autonomously.

Learn more at https://zaplar.com
one_liner: Agentic Hotel Operating System

name: screenpipe
long_description: screenpipe record and learns how you work and turns it into a searchable memory, documents, and AI agents. Data is stored on your device or where your team choose, open source.
one_liner: AI powered by everything you've seen, said or heard

name: Manifold
long_description:
The US Warehouse industry spends $75bn on labor each year. Yet, only 10% of US warehouses have any form of automation, because existing robotics are too expensive and hard to integrate. 

Manifold deploys autonomous robots that handle picking, loading / unloading, and palletizing — priced by pick. Integration in hours. No upfront costs. No retrofitting. No need to rebuild the operation around the robot. 

Our mission is to make it easy for any warehouse to adopt robotics.
one_liner: Low-cost, deployment-ready robotic labor for warehouses

name: Rasyn
one_liner: Towards a General Intelligence for Chemistry

name: Alkera AI
long_description: Alkera is a data engineering/analysis/science agent that works in your IDE or CLI. If you’re tired of agents that produce false, or even dangerous, reports about your data, then Alkera is for you. Our agent is equipped with your data’s history and lineage, your team’s knowledge, and tailored plugins for data apps such as Snowflake and dbt. Simply install and connect your services to begin doing trusted agentic data work. We also offer VPC & on-prem deployment options for when data can't leave your boundary.
one_liner: Reliable and safe data engineering and data science agents

name: Definite
long_description:
Definite is where finance teams build everyday back-office agents on one live model of their books. We plug into your ERP, ledger, payroll, and payments read-only and compile everything into one clean model that stays current as money moves. Your back-office team then builds agents on top in plain English. We never write back and we never move money. The agents are yours, the plumbing is ours.

We met in first year computer science at Waterloo and interned at Meta, Optiver, and BitGo. At Optiver they ran an n8n hackathon and the interns automated basically nothing. It couldn't talk to the systems that mattered. When we pitched banks and fintechs on agents, they kept telling us the same thing. The agent isn't the hard part, getting clean data out of their systems is.

Right now, automating anything in a back office means engineers hand-stitching data from a dozen sources in different formats on different schedules. Tools like n8n and Workato assume your data is already clean and joined. In finance it never is. So the teams with the most repetitive work and smallest budgets get nothing.

The hard part is the compiler. Every source gets cleaned, matched, and joined into one live model of transactions, invoices, vendors, and payments, and it has to stay right as money lands every day. 

Everyone throws engineers at this. We're doing it once so nobody has to again. Every back office is getting agents eventually. Whoever owns the data they read from owns the thing all of them depend on, and eventually the books themselves. That's what we're building.
one_liner: Build everyday back-office agents on one live model of your books

name: Callbook AI
long_description: Callbook AI is a collections agency operated by AI. We collect late stage portfolios by finding, contacting and negotiating with borrowers.
one_liner: AI collections agency for late stage portfolios

name: Tarifflo Inc.
long_description:
Tarifflo is the infrastructure layer for modern customs - AI-powered filing, tariff recovery, and customs intelligence on one platform.

Filing should be free. Legacy ABI software charges you per entry, per user, per module. Brokers charge for every transaction. Tarifflo's filing software costs nothing - file directly with CBP under companies own filer codes.

We make money when our clients do. 1 in 8 entries has an error that overpays duty - misclassification, tariff stacking, valuation, origin. Most importers never catch them. Our AI audits your entries, finds the overpayments, and helps file for your refund. 

Under both is the same engine, live tariff intelligence covering every HTS code, Chapter 99 program, exclusion, and rate change - so the duty you pay going forward is as right as the refunds we recover looking back.
one_liner: Supply chain compliance and cost savings

name: Veltha
long_description:
Veltha is an AI co-adjuster. It puts a defensible decision on the adjuster's desk in hours, so carriers save time and fewer claims reach an attorney.

Learn more at https://veltha.ai
one_liner: AI claims adjuster for regulated insurance

name: Traceforce
long_description:
AI apps such as ChatGPT and Claude have become part of everyone's daily workflow, but they introduce new security risks that traditional security tools weren't built to handle. Security teams at companies from startups to Fortune 500s, are struggling to keep up.

Traceforce gives a company’s security team visibility of how AI apps are being used across company’s devices, and the ability to detect and prevent security breaches and unsafe actions as early as possible.
one_liner: Securing AI native apps directly on devices

name: EdotEnv
long_description:
A Quant Neolab building toward RSI by leveraging markets as self-improving research environments.

They work with frontier AI labs and academic groups building research harnesses, evaluation benchmarks, and post-training environments.
one_liner: A Quant Neolab building toward RSI via quant trading

name: Standard Machines
long_description: We build environments and evaluations to train and evaluate models on advanced chip design.
one_liner: Teaching AI to Design Chips

name: Agency Tool Company
long_description:
Agency Tool Company ships software to robots in the field 20x faster than a Docker pull with ATC Deploy, sending only the bytes that changed and resuming when the network drops. Deployment tooling is the connection between the lab & the field that continually bottlenecks robotics scaling and lacks a strong robotics-native solution. Deploy is live today with 3 launch partners across ag, construction, and logistics robotics.

Our second product, ATC Build, offers embedded-compute as a CI service so devs can run tests and validate their software on the actual target hardware. Build supports the Nvidia Jetson lineup, Raspberry Pi, and a number of other embedded platform targets.

Jack Morrison and Davis Foster founded and sold Scythe Robotics after deploying hundreds of autonomous mowers across the country; Agency Tool Company is building the robotics deployment platform across hardware and software they wish they had.

Learn more at https://agencytool.com
one_liner: Reliable infrastructure to build, deploy and manage real-world robots.

name: Cerenovus
long_description: We are building an AI operating partner that reads every record a company produces to find and prioritize value creation opportunities, including costly operational inefficiencies no one is tracking. Cerenovus warns leaders before small problems become expensive and turns weeks of manual investigation into evidence-backed answers in minutes. Every claim links to its source, and every finding is ranked by impact. Companies use it to improve their operations; private equity and advisory firms deploy it across the businesses they own or advise.
one_liner: AI that finds value creation opportunities across enterprise…

name: Molagri
long_description:
Molagri develops safer, more effective pesticides for agriculture.

We design biopesticides that hit a precise molecular target unique to pest insects, knocking out pests while sparing pollinators, beneficial insects, and the wider ecosystem. By modeling how pests are likely to evolve, we stay a step ahead of resistance, keeping our products effective against the pests of today and tomorrow. The higher efficacy and biobased production will also contribute to emissions reductions in both manufacturing and field use.

Our founders are PhD lab mates from the University of Toronto who have worked together for six years and published in Nature Communications and Nature Microbiology.
one_liner: Resistance free pesticides.

name: Peer
long_description: Peer is building an AI-native freight brokerage that quotes freight, finds the right trucking companies, tracks shipments, and handles problems from pickup through delivery for shippers.
one_liner: AI-native freight brokerage

name: Stratum Industries
long_description:
Stratum Industries is the applied AI company for governments. We build AI agents that automate the slow, complex manual workflows governments run on, starting with application review, where files are still reviewed by hand, one at a time, leaving millions stuck in queues. 

Stratum's agents review applications end to end with a human in the loop and full auditability, clearing entire backlogs in a fraction of the time. Our mission is to deploy AI across every vertical inside the government, saving agencies tens of billions in administrative cost and making the government one of the most efficient institutions in the world.
one_liner: Applied AI for Governments.

name: FlowManual
long_description:
FlowManual is the all-in-one AI estimating, bidding, and purchasing platform for both general and MEP construction contractors.

Built by two engineers and Harvard dropouts, FlowManual automates the buying process during pre-construction. With FlowManual, specialty contractors win more work while general contractors deliver at higher standards.
one_liner: AI for Construction's Back Office.

name: Pluto
long_description:
Resumes made careers readable. LinkedIn made them searchable. Pluto makes them understood.

Professionals talk to Pluto for 10 minutes about what they’ve done, what they’re great at, and what they want next. Pluto makes that context discoverable to the right people and AI agents, helping them understand the professional more fully.

For hiring, companies tell Pluto who they want to meet. Pluto searches its network and the broader market, evaluates fit on both sides, privately confirms interest, and makes warm introductions when both sides want to connect.

18K+ professionals have shared their career context with Pluto. 50+ companies, from fast-growing startups to decacorns, use Pluto to meet people with deeper context and confirmed interest.
one_liner: AI voice agent that helps professionals get discovered

name: machine0
long_description:
machine0 is a CLI for agent compute: `machine0 new mybox` gives your agent a full cloud VM, billed by the minute, from small up to 60 vCPU / 240 GB and 8×H100s. Agents drive it themselves via CLI or MCP.

Agent workloads are moving from ephemeral to always-on. A coding agent working on a hard feature runs 6-8 hours. Auto-research agents run for days. machine0 is the environment in which these agents run.
one_liner: Cloud computers for AI agents

name: Bloomy
long_description: Bloomy helps students learn more efficiently by using AI to identify exactly what a student should learn and when they should learn it. We provide adaptive and personalized curriculum to K-12, starting with English Language Arts, Math, and Writing.
one_liner: AI-powered mastery learning for K-12

name: 6thSense
one_liner: A nervous system for physical AI

name: Nori
long_description:
We manufacture Nori: A sub-$2000 bimanual mobile manipulator that can clean rooms, restock shelves, and fold clothes. Nori can handle basic tasks out of the box, and its software lets anyone teach Nori to automate work specific to their home or business. 

Nori aims to solve the robotics data bottleneck. By deploying affordable robots to customers around the world, we can gather the diverse data required to train the next generation of generalist robotic policies. Every user of Nori makes Nori smarter.

Since launching 6 weeks ago we have already deployed our first robot and have 100k in sales.

We can bring general-purpose robotics to homes and businesses that could never afford it before. There are 132.7 million households and 8.4 million employer business locations in the U.S. At $1,688 per robot, selling just one Nori to 0.5% of them represents a $1.2B market opportunity in the U.S. alone.
one_liner: sub-$2000 humanoid robot you can teach to do anything

name: Ooak Data
long_description: Ooak Data turns internal company data into a training ground where AI agents can be tested on real work.
one_liner: We turn company data into RL environnements.

name: Graphify Labs
long_description:
Graphify builds a queryable knowledge graph from your codebase, docs, and Jira. The open-source engine has 105K+ GitHub stars and ~5M downloads, and is used in production by engineers at Rootly, Geotab, Tweddle Group, and Superagent.

On top of that graph, our enterprise layer reviews every pull request and formally verifies each code change: it proves the new behavior matches the old, or hands back the exact input that breaks it. That makes it built for the changes teams fear most, like refactors, framework upgrades, and large-scale code migrations, where you need proof that nothing broke, not a guess.

The graph updates itself as the code changes and keeps context instead of forgetting it, so your whole team and their coding agents work from one shared, always-current view of the codebase instead of a thousand private threads.

It runs entirely inside your perimeter, fully air-gapped on-premise or self-hosted in your own cloud, so no code or data ever leaves your environment.
one_liner: On-device knowledge graph engine for enterprises

name: Aerogen Systems
long_description:
We are building the future of chip manufacturing.

Chips are more advanced than ever, and the features inside them keep getting smaller. But the cleanroom infrastructure supporting their manufacture has not scaled at the same pace. Intel, TSMC, Samsung, and others spend billions building and operating massive cleanrooms, only to isolate their most advanced wafers from the surrounding facility as much as possible.

We think that architecture is backwards. Instead of making the entire building cleaner, why not make the machinery itself as clean as possible?

Talos is our proprietary tool-integrated purification system. It sits directly inside semiconductor equipment and continuously destroys airborne molecular contaminants before they reach the wafer. Instead of fighting contamination by constantly flooding tools with ultra-high-purity nitrogen, Talos keeps the environment inside the machine 10–100x cleaner, without the massive purge-gas bill.

Talos is powerful on its own, but it is also the foundation for a much bigger vision: the Cleanpipe.

The Aerogen Systems Cleanpipe is an ultra-clean interconnect infrastructure that protects wafers as they move from machine to machine across the fab. Rather than relying on a billion-dollar cleanroom to protect every cubic foot of factory space, Cleanpipe creates a controlled environment only where cleanliness actually matters: around the wafer.

Talos cleans the tools. Cleanpipe connects them. Eventually, we delete the cleanroom and build more advanced chips, at greater scale, with radically less infrastructure. With cleanpipes connecting tools, chip fabs can exist anywhere.
one_liner: Building the future of advanced chip manufacturing.

name: Hilstart
long_description: We build physical agent harnesses to enable AI to debug, validate, and ship functional hardware and software.
one_liner: Autonomous Hardware Testing

name: Greypoint Industries
long_description: We build LEGION, a drone swarm that identifies, geolocates, and tracks every emitter on the battlefield using the enemy’s own radio signals. LEGION enables our warfighters to precisely track previously obscured targets like jammers, command posts, and drone operators so they can proactively respond to threats instead of reacting to them.
one_liner: Building drone swarms that hunt drone operators

name: TareBio
long_description: Our platform develops personalized or population-level vaccines for any disease in weeks by changing only one input: the immune imprint. Instead of trying to predict which antigens might work, we read out immune cells already fighting the disease in the body and reverse-engineer antigens that activate them. We've already run our platform end-to-end and created a vaccine that cured cancer in mice.
one_liner: Vaccines for any cancer or infection in weeks.

name: Almanac
long_description: Almanac is Hermes with a company brain. You message it in Slack or iMessage; it knows what is happening across your company and can use your accounts to get real tasks done for you. It has a full computer, browser and terminal. It takes your Gmail, Calendar, Attio, GitHub, AI convos, docs and meeting notes and compiles them into a Wiki that keeps itself up to date. It keeps a current understanding of what you’re building, who your customers are, what was decided, and what still needs to happen. It can use websites, run code, create files and take actions across your accounts. If it reaches a login, payment or decision it shouldn’t make alone, it pings you or hands you the live browser.
one_liner: The AI that knows your company

name: Orvixo
long_description: Orvixo uses AI to build reactive end-to-end planning and optimisation models for manufacturers.
one_liner: AI advanced planning and optimisation for manufacturers.

name: Whitespace
long_description: Whitespace is the AI operating system for wholesale distributors. It connects to their systems and inboxes to build a living model of their business, then deploys self-improving AI agents to automate work like inventory planning, customer support, and order entry.
one_liner: AI Operating System for Wholesale Distributors

name: Click
long_description:
Click builds useful services that meet users right inside ChatGPT and Claude.
We're starting with a research service that provides external context that the built-in web search misses - like data from professional & social platforms, marketplaces, financials, and more. 
It makes research on people & companies even deeper with specialized, source-backed context beyond built-in web search, while enabling new tasks like comparing live flight fares right inside the chat.
one_liner: Research services for ChatGPT and Claude

name: Akon Labs
one_liner: Nervous System for AI Agents

name: Vendo
long_description:
Vendo is the customization layer that lets your users build their own features and micro-apps directly on top of your product. Rather than waiting on an ever-growing feature backlog, your users can personalize the product to exactly how they work, create their own automations, and integrate hundreds of external tools, all without your team writing a line of code.

Everything runs on your existing API, renders natively in your own theme and components, and executes inside secure sandboxes within your existing security guardrails, so your source code is never touched. Companies can plug Vendo into an agent they already have, or deploy a production-ready agent complete with the ability to take actions in the product, generate UI, and draw on a built-in knowledge base. Vendo is open source and installs with a single command, and we work closely with teams to get it running for their product.
one_liner: Let your users build their own features on top of your product

name: Aktoria Robotics
long_description: Operate any robot, anywhere in the world.
one_liner: Human as API for robots

name: Rational
long_description: Rational builds AI coworkers for accounting firms. Our agents onboard themselves to the firm, build a company brain, and do the work, from month-end close to tax prep. In addition, they follow up with clients and communicate with the right members of your team.
one_liner: AI Employees for Accounting

name: Omanta
long_description:
Omanta is a personalized research lab for patients who have exhausted standard options, want to prepare proactively for recurrence, or are living with an unresolved diagnosis.

We direct the full operational infrastructure, personnel, expertise, and technology of a large research program toward understanding and addressing the challenges of individual patients across oncology, rare disease, and undiagnosed conditions.

For clinicians, we act as a collaborative partner, providing a living roadmap for ongoing patient care built on a rigorous and evolving scientific evidence base.

We fully operationalize patient-specific research programs, covering tissue logistics, diagnostic follow-up, data integration, multiomic analysis, therapeutic strategy development, and more.

Omanta brings context and clarity to complex cases, helping clinicians see more of the scientific picture as they decide how best to care for their patients.
one_liner: A research lab for one

name: Fabraix
long_description:
Fabraix builds state-of-the-art AI red-teaming agents that continuously detect security vulnerabilities in customer-facing AI. Our product, Nyx, has already found vulnerabilities in agents at dozens of Fortune 500 companies. On AgentHarm, the leading benchmark for offensive AI security, Nyx achieved a 78% attack success rate, compared with 67% for GPT-5.6 Sol.

AI agents can change more often than teams can test them. A new model, prompt, tool, permission, or data source can change what an agent does, even when the application code stays the same. And AI is also increasing how much software companies produce and how often it changes. We built Nyx to automate the work required to red-team AI agents. It is multi modal by design and interacts with the target indirectly through controlled replicas of SaaS products and websites that we maintain, placing malicious payloads in webpages, documents, files, messages, and tool outputs to test how an agent behaves under different conditions.

Nyx often finds its first vulnerability within minutes or hours rather than days or weeks. Because the work is fully automated, companies can repeat the test with every change and at a much lower cost than what a 7-figure red-teaming (and point-in-time) engagement would require.

We're also the team behind ACE (Adversarial Cost to Exploit), a benchmark that measures AI security in terms of how much it costs attackers to break an AI system; providing a game-theoretic framework to understand how motivated a rational attacker would be in exploiting the system.
one_liner: The world's frontier hacker for AI agents.

name: Qlo
long_description: Qlo uses AI to automate commercial underwriting end to end, from submission through renewal, for MGAs and program administrators.
one_liner: AI that automates underwriting for commercial insurance carriers

name: Tenor
long_description:
Your AI spend becomes accountable labor: every AI worker gets a job, persistent context, a budget, guardrails, and outcomes you can measure.

Copilots made individuals faster. Agent builders made automations easier to create. Both leave the organization unchanged: same roles, same capacity, same org chart, and leadership still sees AI as a software expense, not labor. 

Tenor makes AI enter the company as labor instead: every employee manages a team of AI workers built around the recurring work of their role, each with a defined job, boundaries, a budget, and a record of what it delivered. Employees provide the judgment. AI workers provide the execution. Leadership finally sees what AI spend returns.
one_liner: AI workers that attribute the outcome back to the token spend

name: Daqstra
long_description: Daqstra is the AI-native orchestration layer for physical R&D. It saves engineers in Aerospace, Energy and Robotics hundreds of man hours managing test infrastructure by connecting fragmented test hardware, bringing live and historical test data into one place, and by giving engineers an API to orchestrate their entire test setup. We enable teams to spend less time rebuilding test infrastructure and more time improving the hardware they test.
one_liner: AI-native orchestration for physical R&D testing

name: Risklytics
long_description: Risklytics is a commercial insurance brokerage for frontier tech: robotics, autonomy, data centers, and energy infrastructure. Insurers are writing AI exclusions into standard liability forms, so companies whose products act in the physical world end up holding risk they thought they had transferred. We specialize in that gap, and we know which carriers in the admitted and surplus lines markets will still underwrite it. If you're building anything that moves, lifts, drives, or powers something, we'd like to talk.
one_liner: Insurance for the Frontier

name: LATO
long_description:
The best investments come from conviction, and conviction comes from understanding a market deeply: its customers, its competitors, and where it's heading.

Today that understanding is slow and expensive to build. Reaching the right people takes weeks, a commercial study costs $300k+, and each one starts from scratch.

LATO does this research end-to-end, combining public data and the fund's own knowledge with first-hand interviews of a market's consumers, experts, and operators. 

This research grounds a simulation of the market to predict how market participants behave.
one_liner: Agent-native research and simulation platform for investors

name: Neuromorphic
long_description: Neuromorphic is building an embodiment-agnostic “brain” that makes robots fast to deploy and easy to manage through natural interfaces like Slack, email, and phone. Our goal is to make deploying robots in wet labs and other physical industries as easy as onboarding a new employee.
one_liner: Building embodiment agnostic robot brains.

name: Neuron Industries
long_description: Neuron is crafting the world’s first purpose-built industrial controller for AI, replacing the antiquated PLCs running every machine and factory. We help customers from chemical processing to nuclear reactors compress controls projects from weeks to hours.
one_liner: Industrial Controllers built for AI

name: PokerClubHub
long_description:
TL;DR: PokerClubHub is the first licensed poker club platform. We protect players’ deposits and allow anyone to open their own poker club and make money.

Regulated online poker sites like PokerStars have open player pools and thus are full of pros and bots, driving players to unregulated private clubs.

Existing poker club platforms like ClubGG have no payments processing. Players deposit with a club owner by sending them crypto for play-money chips. In theory, these chips can be exchanged back for money. However, players can get scammed and withdrawing takes ages.

This model is also broken for honest club owners who have to manually process hundreds of deposits a day. They lose out on rake when they sleep and struggle to get players to trust them.

On PokerClubhub, players deposit with PokerClubHub, not the club owner. We handle all deposits and withdrawals for the club owner, saving them time and increasing their earnings. We pay the rake (if any) to club owners as affiliate fees.

We hold the same gaming license as BetHog (built by founders of FanDuel) and Nexa Poker (part of World Poker Tour). Player deposits are secured using Fireblocks.

You can also play rake-free games with your friends and acquaintances on our platform. We ensure that everyone pays up.
one_liner: Host a Poker Club and Make Money

name: Arbital
long_description:
Arbital lets you trade perps, memes, stocks, and run market-making strategies from one place. In our first 7 months, 2,700 traders have traded $1.35B in volume through Arbital, and we're now doing $435M/month. 

We're building towards a social, mobile-first trading app that brings tokenized equities, crypto, and perps to everyone.
one_liner: The trading terminal for perps, memes, and stocks.

name: Ultrasonium
long_description:
The technologies that define this century, including data centers, rockets, satellites, and robots, are built from complex metal parts. As these systems advance, the parts get harder to make. Past a certain complexity, casting and machining stop working, and the advanced methods that remain are slow, expensive, and hazardous.

Ultrasonium has invented a new manufacturing method to make these critical parts 15x faster and 75% cheaper than the methods they replace, in the U.S. and at scale. Solid metal feedstock goes in and a finished part safely comes out, controlled by a physical AI layer and novel control processes. 

The systems that matter most, in aerospace, energy, and compute, are demanding metal geometries that can't be machined or cast and are too expensive and slow to make with incumbent methods, at a moment when domestic manufacturing capacity is a national priority.

Our founding team has built and innovated some of the most complex engineering systems known to man: quantum computers, superconductors, nuclear reactors, and novel aerospace alloy processing methods.
one_liner: Manufacturing the metal parts the world runs on faster, cheaper, safer

name: Vestris
one_liner: AI native platform for real estate closings
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

name: Moving Atoms
long_description:
Moving Atoms is building world models trained on internet scale video: models that accurately predict physical interactions and are conditioned on robot actions. Our first model, Atom 1, already tops the Physics IQ benchmark. 

An exceptional world model is what makes an exceptional robot model possible, and that's phase two.
LLMs were unlocked by the trillions of text tokens sitting free on the internet. We believe robotics gets unlocked a similar way, by the latent physics information in online video content.
one_liner: World Model Lab for Evaluating and Training Robots.

name: Ekho Labs
long_description: When global shipping breaks, companies pay three times: the emergency freight bill, the commitments they miss, and the weeks their teams lose to firefighting. Ekho customers skip all of it - they get days to weeks of warning and the cheapest/fastest move on each shipment and PO. Everyone else reacts to the same news at the same time; Ekho customers act before it.
one_liner: Decisions for disrupted freight

name: Isengard Industries Inc
long_description:
Isengard Industries is not another drone company.

We build sovereign production: the means for allied nations to make precision-strike and counter-drone systems by the thousand, on their own soil, at a fraction of what the primes charge.

We call it Weapons of Mass Production. The Arsenal of Democracy, rebuilt for the drone age.

More to come, and only where it helps. You know how to reach us.
one_liner: Mass-produced AI strike systems and Counter-UAS

name: Denta
long_description:
Denta saves companies money and time on dental insurance. In two minutes, employers can sign up directly, without dealing with the middlemen who add 25% to the cost.

I started Denta after building software for my dad's 10 dental practices. In scaling the software business to 16k MRR in 10 weeks, I realized I was working on a small problem in dentistry. Existing software sucks, no doubt, but what dentists complain about even more: insurance.

Dental insurance carriers collect $100B per year in premiums. 25% of that is wasted on administrators, brokers, and c-suite salaries. As the son of a dentist, I will not let these companies burn $25B a year. That money should go to employers via reduced costs, dentists via reimbursements, and patients via more coverage.
one_liner: Full Stack Dental Insurance

name: Computable
one_liner: Buy, sell, and redeem GPU hours for any week with instant liquidity

name: TryNearby
long_description: TryNearby connects local businesses with creators who live nearby. Restaurants subscribe monthly and automatically get booked visits from local creators who film, edit, and post a review to the local algorithm. This creates a steady stream of content that compounds into discovery on TikTok, Instagram, and increasingly AI search. Over 100 restaurants and thousands of creators are on the platform across Southern California, with AI agents handling matching, booking, and every creator conversation.
one_liner: Local creators for local businesses

name: Financial Datasets
long_description:
Financial Datasets is the best way to connect your agent to real-time stock market data: fundamentals, filings, ownership, earnings, KPIs, prices, and more.

New data is available within seconds of publication. We are a primary-source provider of financial data. Statements, filings, and disclosures are collected, parsed, and served by us directly.
one_liner: Connect your agent to the stock market

name: Luca IQ
long_description: Luca IQ is an API for deterministic tax calculation and an IRS Authorized e-filing engine - the foundation for accounting firms and fintechs building on tax.
one_liner: API First Tax Engine for CPAs

name: Pacific
long_description:
We mass-produce modular data centers that deploy on stalled infrastructure projects losing billions per week.

Delayed infrastructure projects hemorrhage $1B a week in the US alone - Pacific mass-produces modular data centers that deploy on those sites in days and turn their unused power into revenue.

Data centers are stuck for years waiting for power, while delayed construction sites across the world sit on unused interconnects, losing billions of dollars per week in interest on trillions of dollars of debt. Our pods deploy on those sites and generate revenue for them in days. They use diamond wafers in the cooling system so pods run anywhere on earth, even a desert. 

We'll use the same mechanisms we're building today to deploy compute across the galaxy.
one_liner: Mass-producing and deploying micro data centers for Earth and Space

name: Last Accounting Company
long_description:
Last Accounting Company (LAC) is a full-stack AI accounting firm. We sell the same service (bookkeeping, tax filings, etc.) as a traditional accounting firm, but underneath agents handle everything and a certified accountant signs off. Our service is faster, cheaper, and fully integrated, allowing our clients to focus on what matters, not accounting admin.

LAC replaces both outsourced accountants and legacy accounting software for startups and SMBs. Our system is fully proprietary, from the general ledger to the accounting agents. This allows us to create powerful self-reinforcing loops and ultimately provide a state-of-the-art accounting service.
one_liner: Agent-native accounting firm.

name: Executor
long_description:
Executor.sh is an MCP gateway that allows you to sign in once to all of your integrations and use them with any client.

We enable you to connect your agents to anything (MCP, GraphQL, OpenAPI) so regardless of what you're trying to connect agents to you're able to.

If you're trying to scale agents to access all of your production services, data, etc, you need Executor as a unified management layer.
one_liner: The open source integration management layer for AI.

name: Waybill
long_description:
Hardware teams burn weeks on procurement. An engineer needs a part. Someone emails five distributors, chases quotes, gets an approval, wires the money, tracks a shipment across three carriers, clears customs, and then nobody knows where the box is or what's actually on the shelf.

Waybill runs that entire loop. Send us a part, a spec, or a BOM. We source it, pull quotes, route approvals, pay the supplier, handle freight and customs, track it to your dock, and keep your stock count updated. 

Take your supply chain for granted.

Built by a team that's seen it at LAT Aerospace and WareIQ (YC S20).
one_liner: Managed procurement & inventory for hardware teams.

name: RonanRx Inc.
long_description:
RonanRX helps you personalize GLP-1s like Ozempic, peptides, and other treatments using your labs, wearables, medical history, treatment response, and the latest medical research. Instead of treating the average patient, we continuously personalize your treatment as your body changes.

We've built the complete feedback loop for personalized medicine: your health data automatically syncs into one place, AI helps personalize treatment, licensed doctors make prescribing decisions, medications are delivered to your door, and every outcome continuously improves your protocol.

Connect your health data once. RonanRX automatically syncs your labs, wearables, and medical records into a single AI-powered health profile that helps personalize GLP-1s like Ozempic, peptides, supplements, and other treatments around your biology. If prescribed, your medication is delivered to your door.

Our founders have built and exited multiple companies, raised over $100M, and previously built a $50M U.S. medical manufacturing business.

Start with a text at RonanRX.com and become the maximum version of yourself,
one_liner: We use AI to personalize peptides to your biology

name: Marengo
long_description:
Marengo designs data centers at double the speed and half the cost with AI. We’re working with some of the largest data center builders in the world to improve how design is done today.

We're backed by Y Combinator, a16z & Index Venture Scout Funds, as well as investors/angels in OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX, and more.

Our advisors include the former President & CEO of Saipem America ($3B+ P&L), former President of Exyte's Advanced Technology Facilities GBU ($6B+ P&L) and more.
one_liner: Automating engineering design, starting with data centers.

name: Lumeria
long_description: The Lumoscope is a multispectral camera that clips onto your phone and scans your skin at home with the same light used in clinics. You see what a mirror can't: a breakout days before it surfaces, and wrinkles changing over time. Our software then reads that history, connects flare-ups to causes you'd never suspect, and matches products to what your own data shows works.
one_liner: Oura Ring for Skin

name: Familiar
long_description:
Familiar is breaking down every language barrier.

Sales and Demos, Education, Telehealth, Advertising, Live Shopping, Entertainment.

Founders An Zhu Liu, Mingi Kwon, and Xu Zheng lead a team of PhDs, professors, and researchers from the world's top universities who started the field of joint audio-visual human models and co-authored the current state of the art in real-time human animation.

They're building world models for accurate humans: understanding, editing, and predicting.

They started with video language translation, and they've already built one of the most accurate translators available today, the only one that works in real time. It outperforms industry leaders (ElevenLabs, YouTube, HeyGen, Meta), as shown in Familiar's published benchmarks: https://thefamiliarlab.com/benchmark

🦋 Content, now in every language. Exactly the same as the original.
one_liner: World Models for Accurate Humans.

name: Markov
long_description: We source high quality tasks and data to train the next generation of computer use AI models.
one_liner: Data for computer-use ai

name: Cosmic Robotics
long_description:
Our mission is to build a city on Mars. 

Cosmic-1, the first equipment in our fleet, is an autonomous robot capable of heavy-lift manipulation. Its been deployed on some of the largest solar farms in the US, more than doubling labor productivity across tens of thousands of panel installs. 

We're scaling in solar, expanding in data centers, and building lunar construction robotics under contract with NASA.
one_liner: Autonomous construction on Earth and beyond

name: Operon
long_description:
Operon is the data intelligence layer for heavy industry. We ingest the messy documents a plant runs on (P&IDs, schematics, datasheets, scans) and turn them into one structured, queryable model of the facility.

On top of it, engineers query their plant in natural language and build agentic workflows for safety, compliance, and design.
one_liner: Agentic data layer for manufacturing & process industries.

name: Inkbox
long_description: For your AI agents to behave like teammates, we give them persistent identities with their own email, phone, and iMessage. We also provide them an agent-to-agent channel, so they can communicate for task delegation.
one_liner: Let your agents communicate via email, phone, iMessage, & Agent2Agent

name: Gamgee
long_description:
​Gamgee began with Rosie, founder Paul Conyngham’s dog. After surgery, chemotherapy and immunotherapy failed, Rosie was given months to live. Paul used AI and genomic analysis to identify targets in her tumour, then worked with scientists at UNSW to produce what is believed to be the first fully computationally designed mRNA cancer vaccine delivered to a dog. Following treatment, several tumours shrank significantly and her quality of life improved

Gamgee is building an end to end platform for personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs. We sequence a dog’s tumour and healthy DNA, identify mutations unique to its cancer, and design a vaccine that teaches the immune system what to attack. We manage the entire process- from vet intake and tissue collection through genomic analysis, vaccine production, treatment and response monitoring

​We are now turning that one off effort into a repeatable clinical system. Gamgee is running clinical trials in Australia, working with vets, oncologists and specialised laboratories, and accepting cases globally. Our goal is to make personalised cancer treatment accessible to every dog that needs it- and use each case to improve the treatment for the next
one_liner: Scalable Personalised Cancer Treatment

name: ProvenMetal
long_description:
ProvenMetal manufactures the fastest circuit boards in the United States.

Domestic circuit board manufacturing is slow and expensive, and while reshoring is happening, the supply chain isn't there yet.

We automate the bottlenecks - part procurement, DFM review, and assembly - delivering circuit boards in days instead of weeks.
one_liner: Fast-turn, American made PCBs

name: Agentcard
long_description: Agentcard.sh is a debit card for AI agents. Agents can use Agentcard’s API to issue cards and pay for things online autonomously.
one_liner: debit cards for AI agents.

name: Agnost AI
long_description:
Agnost AI helps teams building chat and voice AI agents understand what users want, where they get stuck, and why they drop off.

We read production AI conversations, cluster recurring intents, feature requests, frustration, and failure patterns, then open PRs against prompts, tools, and harnesses to improve the agent.
one_liner: Product analytics for AI Agents

name: Radley
long_description:
Radley is the first AI-native radiology practice. We're acquiring a radiology practice bringing Radley to $4.3M in annualized revenue and rebuilding it with agents from the ground up.

Radiology is already in crisis: there aren't enough radiologists to interpret 1 in 6 medical scans. In 10 years, that gap is growing to 1 in 3 - 246M scans a year.

From past experience, we know that point solutions won’t cut it. While there is demand (we have $2.2M in contracts to prove it), bottleneck isn't just software, it's outdated systems and slow, inefficient operations. That's why we own the full stack, clinical and operational, end to end.

We met at Carbon Health as we scaled operations 31x and expanded to 100+ clinics. Now we're rebuilding radiology.
one_liner: AI-native, full-stack radiology practice

name: Care GP
long_description: Care GP is building AI agents to run operations for primary healthcare clinics
one_liner: AI agents to run primary healthcare operations

name: Praxis Robotics
long_description: Praxis captures the data physical AI is bottlenecked on: egocentric video, 3D scans, and multimodal capture from inside real industrial and residential environments. Embedded within publicly listed and unicorn-scale conglomerates, we reach 60k workers across 5 continents and 150+ environment types, supplying the real-world training data frontier labs and humanoid companies can't source anywhere else.
one_liner: Turns every company into a data vendor

name: Levocred AI
long_description: Levocred AI is an AI-native platform for credit funds, fintechs and banks to automate workflows like back-office tasks, portfolio monitoring, compliance and underwriting. Live across multiple credit teams, running ~$1Bn in receivables through the platform.
one_liner: AI for credit funds, fintechs and banks

name: Axelrod
long_description: Autonomous software for hotels that takes over all front-of-house and back-of-house tasks with zero integrations, running operations better than your staff would. Axelrod is trusted by Michelin Key awarded boutique hotels and is live across 4 continents.
one_liner: Boutique Hotels that run themselves

name: CarSignal
long_description:
CarSignal is the AI-native operating system for independent auto repair shops.

Most shops still run each repair across disconnected management software, scan tools, parts catalogs, service information, texts, spreadsheets, and knowledge kept in technicians’ heads. That fragmentation slows diagnosis, creates duplicate admin, and leaves customers waiting.

CarSignal connects the full repair process in one system. AI agents research vehicle-specific failure patterns and surface the tests that confirm or rule out each cause. The same system carries each job from booking and intake through inspections, estimates, parts, approvals, payment, and follow-up, so technicians spend less time searching and updating systems and more time fixing cars.
one_liner: The Smart Operating System for Auto Shops.

name: Decawork
long_description:
Decawork gives IT teams one place to deploy, govern and maintain the AI agents running across their company.

Building internal AI tools and agents is getting easier. Turning them into company-owned systems is still hard. What follows is agent sprawl: deployment gets messy, agents go live with access to real systems and real data, and maintenance falls in the gap. IT can't see any of it, so it does the only two things it can: first ignore, then block. Ignoring piles up risk; blocking kills the productivity people just found. 

With Decawork, every agent ships one standard way: its own identity and scoped credentials, with IT's sign-off before it goes live. After that, every run is watched - IT is alerted the moment something fails, agents nobody uses get retired. And the whole time, IT sees every agent, controls what it can touch, and audits every action, with approvals gating anything sensitive.

Every big shift - cloud, SaaS, the digital workspace - ended with IT running it. Agents aren't just the next shift, they're the next workforce, bigger than the human one. Decawork is what IT will run them with.
one_liner: The Agent Control Plane for IT teams

name: Pennant
long_description: Led by former institutional proxy voters and technologists with a collective 20+ years of experience, Pennant gives institutional investors, public companies, and corporate advisors voting and governance intelligence to act on their own principles at scale.
one_liner: The Corporate Governance OS for Public Markets

name: Derya
long_description:
Derya deploys supply chain automations for startups, SMEs, and enterprises that fulfil their entire supply chain function, from prospecting and procurement to distribution of goods.

Our mission is to rebuild the supply chain from the ground up, turning one of the world’s hardest coordination problems into an AI native system that moves commodities by being integrated into both the supply chain infrastructure and the customer. We work across robotics, commodities, and food & beverages companies; procuring goods and managing various operation functions for them.
one_liner: Agentic Supply Chain Automations

name: Touchy
long_description: Touchy is your personal AI assistant that lives on your iPhone. It sees what you see and talks to your other apps to take care of work so you can get back to living in the moment.
one_liner: The AI assistant that doesn't fight for your attention

name: Mireye
long_description:
AI agents are starting to act in the real world, but they can't reliably understand it. 

Every fact about a place has its own silo: land in GIS maps, power in utility portals, people in census tables, policy in county PDFs. All built for humans, none for agents. Underneath, the data is fragmented across thousands of sources, unstructured and complex.

Mireye is building the infrastructure that powers agents to make decisions and act in the real world. One API and MCP to connect agents to the physical world with accurate data enrichment, signals and tools.

Our mission is to index every inch of the earth, and make it as queryable as the web.
one_liner: Infrastructure for Physical World AI Agents

name: Shiraz AI
long_description:
We deploy robots that learn new tasks from a single human demonstration in the factory. We're starting in contract manufacturing, where lines change every week and both traditional automation and today's VLAs fall over.

Our founding team has 20+ years of experience in robotics. Navid was part of the core team that productized Spot at Boston Dynamics and led manipulation projects there. Before that, he was at Rethink Robotics. Mojtaba led whole-body control and manipulation efforts at Amazon Robotics and was a Research Assistant Professor at Northwestern University.
one_liner: Robots that learn on the job

name: Lamb Labs
long_description: Lamb Labs is building custom chips for AI inference and the world's fastest LLM model at the lowest power. We've developed a new post-training technique that converts existing models to a diffusion-based architecture that delivers 2× faster inference on existing GPUs. We then build the hardware, custom silicon chips targeting up to 20,000+ tok/s and a 63× higher intelligence per watt.
one_liner: World's fastest AI models

name: Chromie
long_description: The intelligent operating system for government contracting. Built by former AI engineers and government officials.
one_liner: find, qualify, & win contracts with AI

name: 83 Sciences
long_description: 83 Sciences uses AI to mine discarded experimental data and drive scientific breakthroughs. Working alongside labs, we discover the materials that will power the new Industrial Revolution.
one_liner: AI-native materials discovery powered by unpublished experimental data

name: Palisade
one_liner: AI that finds and fixes OS-level vulnerabilities across device fleets

name: Hubble
long_description:
Hubble retrieves complete medical records on behalf of patients using patient-mediated access. Under a patient's HIPAA right of access, they authorize us once and we pull their full history from every provider they've seen (hospitals, clinics, labs, imaging centers), no per-provider integration or IT project required.

Getting records today still runs on faxes, patient portals, and release-of-information queues, so teams that need medical data wait weeks and get back a pile of unstructured PDFs. Hubble handles the retrieval end to end and returns clean, structured records, turning what used to take weeks into days.

We work with teams that live or die on getting patient records fast: legal (personal injury, mass tort, disability), life sciences and research, and anyone building products that need a patient's real medical history to work. Instead of standing up records infrastructure themselves, they use Hubble as the retrieval layer.

We're the team behind the AI agents at Grow Therapy and Amazon's One Medical used by millions of patients (Prabha was Grow's first PM building their AI agents, Aaron built the AI infra serving 1M+ clients).
one_liner: The intelligence layer for patient information

name: Skymerse
long_description: Skymerse is building one AI system for airline flight operations: from planning and monitoring in the operations center to real-time support in the cockpit. It is developing specialized aeronautical models that understand the data, constraints, and procedures behind each flight, replacing fragmented tools and manual interpretation. Notamify, its first product, already serves airline customers and thousands pilots and aviation professionals.
one_liner: Autopilot for Flight Operations

name: Grip
long_description: Grip is a robotics company building intelligent robotic systems for waste and recycling. Its technology combines learning-based manipulation and custom hardware to identify and pick objects from messy, constantly changing waste streams. By learning from real-world operating data, including every successful and failed grasp, Grip’s systems become more reliable and adaptable over time. The goal is to help waste operators reduce difficult manual sorting, recover more valuable material, lower contamination, and deploy automation more flexibly across different facilities and waste streams. Ultimately, Grip is building the intelligent manipulation layer for waste infrastructure, making recycling and the circular economy more efficient and scalable.
one_liner: Robotics for waste management

name: HyperProbe
long_description:
If your team uses Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex to ship, you've felt it: the AI is great at writing code, mediocre at debugging it. When something breaks in prod, you're back to grepping logs, adding console.logs, redeploying, and hoping the AI's guess is right.

HyperProbe fixes this. Your coding agent dynamically drops non-breaking probes into your running services, straight from your IDE. When a probe fires, HyperProbe captures and sanitises the exact variable state, feeding your agent real evidence instead of flat logs. 

This fixes prod incidents in minutes from the exact same window where agents write code, without ever redeploying to add a print statement. Under 1% CPU overhead. Automatic PII redaction. 

Built for backend teams shipping AI-written code today. Install in 60 seconds, see your first investigation in 10 minutes. That's why we call HyperProbe the runtime data layer for AI-native software.
one_liner: Your coding agent writes code. Now let it fix prod too.

name: TovenAI
long_description:
TovenAI builds a platform of AI agents that handle manual, data-intensive work for compliance teams at institutional trading firms, with six agents currently live. Our customers range from specialist firms to large global institutions, with our agents supporting multiple compliance workflows at a top-10 institutional brokerage.

With prebuilt connectors to more than 30 systems—including Bloomberg, Cloud9, and NICE Actimize—firms can onboard to our platform and evaluate results using their own data in less than a week.
one_liner: AI agents for compliance at institutional trading firms

name: Verdict Machine
all_locations: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
long_description:
Verdict Machine uses AI to understand each financial institution's complete on-chain environment, assess its cyber risk and generate tailored controls. The same live model powers transaction prevention, continuous cyber diligence, security posture and cost-efficient wallet screening. Before execution, Verdict Machine evaluates proposed transactions against the institution's active policies.

In our first weeks, we started POCs with asset managers and digital-asset infrastructure providers whose systems move billions of dollars every week for financial institutions. We're now in active evaluations with digital-asset teams at some of the world's largest banks.

The founding team launched and led blockchain security at Check Point (NASDAQ: CHKP).
one_liner: AI cybersecurity for financial institutions' digital assets

name: Dock
long_description: Dock is a multiplayer agent workspace where you spin up teams of specialized, proactive agents that can do the work of entire departments. They communicate, unblock each other, and manage each other to get work done, so you're not the bottleneck babysitting a dozen chat windows.
one_liner: Multiplayer agent workspace to run your company

name: OpenRelay
one_liner: Distributed, hardware-agnostic AI inference

name: Agent FM
long_description: Agent FM is a desktop app that gives engineers one group chat to hear and steer their coding agents. name: SpaceFlow Technologies, Inc.

SpaceFlow agents normalize multi-round quotations, chase suppliers and delivery confirmations, repair incomplete requests, classify materials, reconcile phantom inventory, surface market signals, and help sales and operations planning teams continuously align demand, supply, inventory, purchasing deadlines, and freight decisions.

SpaceFlow deploys in the customer’s cloud or on-prem environment with permissions, human approvals, observability, and audit trails, allowing industrial and regulated enterprises to automate high-stakes operations without replacing existing systems or moving sensitive data.

name: Amulet

We provide isolated, writable workspaces that mount in under 100 ms and fork without copying data. Work persists across disposable compute, and every workspace can be snapshotted, reproduced, merged, or rolled back. We’re working with agentic automated-research labs, cloud agent providers, and other to bring this infrastructure to data-intensive AI teams.

name: Tracer

Our work spans reasoning, code, research, and agentic systems, with the goal of making advanced intelligence more accessible and economical.

Teams get per-agent access control, full audit logs, and one-click integrations with Gmail, GitHub, Jira, Slack, and 50+ other apps. OneCLI is open source (2.5K+ GitHub stars, 300K+ downloads), Already the default credential layer for products like NanoClaw.

name: hiloop
long_description:
hiloop helps teams train agents for tasks where general models are not good enough. Give us a task, your current agent or model, and an evaluation. hiloop runs an autoresearch campaign across data, SFT and other post-training methods, continual learning, prompts, tools, harnesses, and systems, then returns the best verified improvement. It runs hosted or in your cloud.

We provide the research system around models: persistent memory, full experiment lineage, compute orchestration, and statistical verification. We’re starting with agent and model training, continual learning, and optimization.

Reach out to us for early access at founders@hiloop.ai.
one_liner: Infrastructure for recursive self-improvement

name: Robocurve
long_description:
Robocurve builds open-source tools and independent benchmarks to measure how well robots can do real-world jobs. Instead of relying on unverified demo videos from frontier labs, we score their models on reproducible benchmarks that anyone can trust.

Today there are no well-run, standardized robotics benchmarks. Labs evaluate in-house, and no independent group has stepped in to run continuous benchmarking as a service. The result is that no one actually knows how good anyone else is, or where the real frontier sits.

Good benchmarks require operating and maintaining physical hardware and real-world setups. Simulation only goes so far, since models that look strong in sim can show large performance gaps once deployed in the real world. Building real-world benchmarks means coordinating job-domain experts, evals engineering, and hands-on robotics all at once.

Frontier labs are targeting general-purpose robotics by 2028, yet the field of robotics evals barely exists. Whoever builds the trusted measure of robot capability becomes the reference everyone relies on. We combine backgrounds in AI evals and robotics to build and grow this field as fast as possible. We already shipped v1 of our open-source framework, Inspect Robots, and ran our first pilot scoring a frontier model on a real robot.
one_liner: Evaluating robots in the real world.

name: Salem Robotics Inc
long_description: Our software turns any robot we deploy into an everyday independent worker at your facility. They are able to walk sites, handle instruments, overcome obstacles, collect measurements, and generate auditable compliance records, replacing hours of mandatory manual surveys and inspections. Built by Los Alamos robotics veterans and deterministic-manipulation researchers, we're starting in nuclear and expanding to other hazardous industries.

name: Osseus
long_description:
Osseus is the intelligent development platform for robotics. It plugs into the tools a team already uses - CAD, ECAD, GitHub, Jira, docs, messaging, and test runs - creating a live dependency graph of their entire robot stack. It automatically builds and maintains the relationships between every part, board, requirement, test, and decision.

When a hardware change is made, the map traces the downstream impact across mechanical, electrical, and software. Osseus's agents find which requirements may be compromised, run the attached tests and sims, create fixes for the affected hardware/software on branches, and re-run the tests to confirm the new design doesn’t break downstream.

Osseus includes a robotics component marketplace. Teams can list spare parts and hardware for others to buy/rent during prototyping, and designs can be evaluated against real component availability. If a part has a long lead time or is unavailable, engineers can quickly find compatible alternatives in their area instead of waiting weeks or asking around their network.

Design review also happens in Osseus. Engineers see why a design might not work, what's been tried before, and why something was built the way it was, pulled from prior conversations between engineers and with suppliers. Suppliers comment directly on a part through a secure link instead of back and forth over email, and what they say is remembered. If a supplier flags that a design isn't machinable, or that changing a feature would cut cost, that insight automatically appears the next time someone designs something similar, saving time and money.

We ultimately will use the platform's deep engineering understanding to develop physical-AI models that reason jointly over the robot's geometry, electronics, kinematics, components, software, and real-world performance so people can optimize and iterate on robots much faster. Get in touch to learn more!
one_liner: The intelligent development platform for robotics
